title: C005419 Senior Project Transition Manager (NS) - MON 5 Oct
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Emw
description_html:
Deadline Date: Monday 5 October 2026

Requirement: Senior Project Transition Manager

Location: Wiesbaden, DE

Full Time On-Site: Yes

Time On-Site: 100%

Total Scope of the request (hours): 350

Required Start Date: 10 November 2026

End Contract Date: 23 December 2026

Required Security Clearance: NATO SECRET

 

Duties & Role: 

Project Transition to Operations

  • Leads the transition of projects and capabilities into operational service, from early engagement in project planning through to formal handover and early life support.
  • Defines and agrees transition plans, entry and exit criteria, service acceptance criteria and handover deliverables with Project Managers, Service Owners and customers.
  • Ensures operational readiness prior to go-live: support model, staffing, training, documentation, spares, underpinning contracts, monitoring and configuration data are in place.
  • Evaluates project outputs against agreed service acceptance criteria and formally recommends acceptance, conditional acceptance or rejection.
  • Identifies, manages and escalates transition risks, issues and dependencies, and ensures residual risks are understood and owned by operations.
  • Manages early life support and closes transition only when agreed service performance has been demonstrated.
  • Captures and applies lessons identified to improve future transitions.

Local Operations Management (Wiesbaden)

  • Takes accountability for the day-to-day delivery of NCIA services at the location, including service performance, customer satisfaction and compliance with security and safety requirements.
  • Leads and coordinates local technical, support and contractor personnel, setting clear priorities, standards and direction.
  • Oversees the local infrastructure (facilities, networks, data centre / server rooms, end-user and deployable CIS assets) and ensures it is maintained, secured and fit for purpose.
  • Ensures asset and configuration management records for the location are accurate and complete.
  • Coordinates local business continuity and service recovery arrangements.

Incident and Problem Management

  • Ensures incidents are logged, prioritised, diagnosed and resolved according to agreed procedures and service levels.
  • Leads the resolution of major incidents, coordinating technical teams, vendors and customers, and provides timely, accurate communication to senior stakeholders.
  • Escalates unresolved incidents and facilitates recovery following resolution.
  • Initiates and monitors problem investigations, drives root cause analysis and ensures preventive measures are implemented.
  • Analyses incident and problem trends to reduce recurrence and improve service stability.

Change Management

  • Manages the change control process for services and assets at the location and for services in transition.
  • Assesses changes for risk, impact, cost and resource requirements, and represents the location in Change Advisory Boards.
  • Ensures changes are planned, communicated, tested, implemented and reviewed in a controlled manner, minimizing disruption to operations.

Service Level Management

  • Negotiates service level requirements and agreed service levels with customers, and contributes to Service Level Agreements, Operational Level Agreements and underpinning contracts.
  • Monitors service performance and key performance indicators, diagnoses service delivery problems and initiates improvement actions.
  • Provides accurate and regular performance reporting to NCIA management and customers.
  • Drives continual service improvement across processes, tools and third-party delivery.

Cost, Resource and Vendor Management

  • Manages the operational and transition budget for the location, including cost planning, forecasting, tracking and variance reporting.
  • Provides inputs to customer budget processes, cost models and service rates, ensuring the full cost of operating transitioned services is identified and funded.
  • Identifies cost optimisation opportunities without compromising service levels or security.
  • Manages vendor and contractor performance against contractual obligations, statements of work and service levels, and supports procurement activities as required.

 

Specific Working Conditions: Occasional travel within NATO nations, including to operational sites, may be required.

Requirements

Skills, Knowledge & Experience:

  • The candidate must have a currently active NATO SECRET security clearance
  • A minimum requirement of a Bachelor's degree at a nationally recognised/certified university in Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration or a related discipline, and 8 years' post-related experience.
  • Or exceptionally, the lack of a university degree may be compensated by the demonstration of a candidate's particular abilities or experience that is/are of interest to the NCI Agency, that is, at least 12 years' extensive and progressive expertise in duties related to the function of the post.
  • Minimum 8 years of combined experience in IT service management and project management, of which at least 3 years in a senior role.
  • Proven experience (minimum 5 years) in IT service management in a Service Delivery Manager, IT Operations Manager or similar role, including incident, problem, change and service level management.
  • Proven experience (minimum 5 years) in project management, delivering complex IT/CIS projects to time, cost and quality.
  • Demonstrable track record of transitioning projects or new capabilities into live operational service.
  • Proven experience engaging, influencing and briefing senior stakeholders at executive (C-level) or General/Flag Officer level.
  • Experience managing IT infrastructure (networks, data centres, servers, end-user and communications systems) in an operational environment.
  • Experience in budget and cost management, including forecasting, cost control and financial reporting.
  • Proven experience managing vendors and contractors against contractual and service level obligations.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams in an international environment.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions under pressure.
  • ITIL 4 Foundation (or ITIL v3 Foundation).
  • Project management certification: PMP (PMI / PMBOK) or PRINCE2 Practitioner.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience in NATO, military, defence or other international organisations.
  • Experience with deployable CIS or mission-critical communications services.
  • ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader; MSP or PgMP; SIAM certification.
  • Experience with ITSM tools (e.g. ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, Jira Service Management).
  • Knowledge of NATO procurement and financial processes.
  • Working knowledge of German.

title: Solution Architect – Client Solutions (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Fincite Gmbh
description_html:
Deine Herausforderungen

  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden und unseren Entwicklungsteams und verbringst einen wesentlichen Teil deiner Zeit im direkten Austausch mit Kunden.
  • Du hörst genau hin, verstehst die Kundenprobleme und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in technische Fragestellungen, die unsere Entwickler konkret bearbeiten können.
  • Auf Basis deines tiefen technischen Hintergrunds entwickelst du Lösungsarchitekturen, die sowohl zu den Anforderungen des Kunden als auch zu unserer eigenen Systemlandschaft passen.
  • Dabei denkst du in Systemen: Du verstehst unsere Architektur, die technische Umgebung unserer Kunden, Datenflüsse, Schnittstellen und Abhängigkeiten und kannst diese Welten sinnvoll zusammenbringen.
  • Bei APIs und Integrationen kannst du nicht nur Anforderungen formulieren, sondern auch auf technischer Ebene mit unseren Entwicklern über Lösungswege und deren Auswirkungen diskutieren.
  • Du begleitest Projekte von der ersten Anforderung bis zur Umsetzung und stellst sicher, dass aus einer guten technischen Idee auch eine funktionierende Lösung wird.
  • Als Bindeglied zwischen Kunden, Projektteams und Engineering sorgst du für Klarheit: Was ist das eigentliche Problem? Was brauchen wir technisch? Was ist sinnvoll umsetzbar?
  • Du bringst Struktur in komplexe Themen, koordinierst unterschiedliche Stakeholder und behältst auch bei mehreren Projekten den Überblick.


Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Solution Architecture, Technical Consulting, Product Management, Softwareentwicklung oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle an der Schnittstelle von Business und Technologie.
  • Ein gutes technisches Verständnis für Softwarearchitekturen, Datenflüsse, Schnittstellen und API-Design. Ein Entwicklerhintergrund ist dabei ein klarer Vorteil, aber kein Muss.
  • Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und die Fähigkeit, Kundenprobleme und fachliche Anforderungen wirklich zu verstehen und in klare, umsetzbare technische Anforderungen zu übersetzen.
  • Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering: Du kannst technische Themen auf Augenhöhe diskutieren, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich vermitteln und gemeinsam mit Entwicklern pragmatische Lösungen entwickeln.
  • Interesse an Wealth Management, Finanztechnologie und SaaS sowie die Bereitschaft, dich tief in fachliche und technische Zusammenhänge einzuarbeiten.
  • Erfahrung mit agilen Methoden, ausgeprägtes Organisationstalent und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder zusammenzubringen und Lösungen strukturiert bis in die Umsetzung zu begleiten.


Unser Angebot

Wir sind ein etabliertes Produktunternehmen mit dem Spirit eines Startups. Dich erwarten Teamgeist, schnelle Entscheidungen und echte Freiheit, dein Arbeitsumfeld zu gestalten. Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Weiterbildungsbudgets und attraktive Benefits geben dir Raum für persönliche Entwicklung, Karrieremöglichkeiten und ein erfülltes Leben.


Sprachkenntnisse

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau 
  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.


Ansprechpartner/in

Julian Eder

description_html:
teamHOLDING GmbH

Wir, die teamHOLDING Gmbh stehen für Vielfalt mit Haltung – und für Angebote, die Menschen in ihrer Entwicklung stärken. Unser Schwerpunkt liegt im pädagogischen Bereich, ergänzt durch erlebnispädagogische Programme und unterstützende Dienstleistungen.  

Zur Unterstützung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort eine motivierte und zuverlässige Person im Bereich Fuhrparkmanagement und Verwaltung.  


Daily Business

  • Unterstützung bei der Organisation und Verwaltung unseres Fuhrparks
  • Planung, Koordination und Überwachung von Inspektionen, Wartungen, Reparaturen und gesetzlichen Prüfungen (z. B. TÜV, AU)
  • Koordination und Wahrnehmung von Terminen rund um unsere Fahrzeuge
  • Verwaltung und Bearbeitung von Schadensfällen und Unfällen
  • Kommunikation und Abstimmung mit Werkstätten, Leasinggesellschaften, Versicherungen und weiteren Dienstleistern
  • Überwachung von Fristen sowie Dokumentation relevanter Fahrzeugunterlagen
  • Unterstützung bei Fahrzeugübernahmen und -rückgaben
  • Kontrolle und Verwaltung von Betriebskosten, beispielsweise für Kraftstoff, Wartung und Leasing
  • Unterstützung bei allgemeinen organisatorischen und administrativen Aufgaben
  • Unterstützung in der Kreditoren- und Debitorenbuchhaltung, sowie der Monatssteuer
  • Erfassung und Prüfung von Geschäftsvorgängen
  • Mithilfe bei Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen


Deine Skills

  • Laufendes Studium, beispielsweise im Bereich Wirtschaft, Verwaltung, Mobilität oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
  • Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit
  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
  • Hohe Motivation und Zuverlässigkeit
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office
  • Führerschein Klasse B


Deine Benefits

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung und individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Ein abwechslungsreiches Aufgabenfeld mit viel Eigenverantwortung
  • Ein engagiertes, aufgeschlossenes und kreatives Team
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich gut mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen
Wer wir sind? 

Zur teamHOLDING GmbH gehören unter anderem: teamZUKUNFT gGmbH – freier Träger der Kinder- und Jugendhilfe sowie Programmanbieter für Klassenfahrten und Feriencamps, teamEXPERTE GmbH – erlebnispädagogische Outdoor- und Teamtrainings sowie Aus- und Weiterbildung, teamJUGENDHERBERGEN GmbH – eigene Programmhäuser wie die Jugendherberge Hilchenbach sowie teamSERVICE GmbH – Hausmeister- und Facility-Services. 

Was uns verbindet: Wir schaffen Räume, in denen Menschen wachsen – mit Herz, Haltung und einem starken Team.

title: Maintainer (m/dw/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Velptec
description_html:
Über uns

Richte dich neu aus. Auf deine Zukunft. Mit velpTEC.

velpTEC ist ein auf innovative Technologien ausgerichtetes Weiterbildungsinstitut, das Erfahrungen aus Wirtschaft, Zukunftsforschung und neuen Bildungsansätzen verbindet. Wir unterstützen Menschen durch unsere Bildungsangebote praxisnah dabei, ihre Fähigkeiten für künftige Zeiten zu stärken und damit aktiv ihren Lebensweg zu gestalten. In unserem Handeln legen wir Wert auf gesellschaftliche Verantwortung, Fortschritt und Selbstbestimmung. 

Bereit für eine neue Mission? Dann entdecke jetzt deine Zukunftsperspektive bei velpTEC und werde Teil unseres multiprofessionellen und diversen Teams. 

Wir bauen unsere digitalen Produkte in einem neuen, KI-nativen Produktteam mit fünf klaren Rollen: Prototyper, Builder, Sweeper, Grower und Maintainer. Jede Rolle hat einen eigenen Auftrag im Lebenszyklus eines Produkts, von der ersten Idee bis zum verlässlichen Betrieb. Gearbeitet wird an unserem Online-Campus, unseren Websites, unserem Shop und an neuen KI-gestützten Lern- und Vertriebsprodukten. 

Du möchtest dafür sorgen, dass ein Produkt trägt, sobald Menschen sich darauf verlassen? Als Maintainer (m/w/d) hältst du unsere gereiften Systeme schnell, sicher und verfügbar, während Nutzendenzahlen und Funktionsumfang wachsen. Du automatisierst den Betrieb, machst den Zustand der Systeme jederzeit sichtbar und bringst Störungen strukturiert und ruhig zu Ende. Das Erfahrungslevel halten wir offen: Junior bis Senior ist möglich. Entscheidend ist deine Lust, gemeinsam mit KI-Werkzeugen großartige Ergebnisse zu gestalten.


Was deine Aufgaben sein werden

  • Verfügbarkeit & Performance: Monitoring, Alerting und Zielwerte für Verfügbarkeit und Antwortzeiten aufbauen und einhalten
  • Betrieb automatisieren: Deployments, Updates, Backups und Wiederherstellung über Infrastructure as Code und Pipelines abbilden
  • Störungen beheben: Vorfälle systematisch eingrenzen, beheben, Ursachen dokumentieren und Wiederholungen ausschließen

description_html:
Wir suchen jemanden, der bei uns Newsletter schreibt und sie gleich fertig baut.

Kurz zu uns: Wir sind Rügamer & Steiner aus Düsseldorf, über 35 Leute, und wir machen E-Mail-Marketing für mehr als 150 Online-Shops. In Zahlen: 8 E-Mails pro Sekunde, 250 Millionen Empfänger im Jahr. Jede einzelne Zeile davon hat jemand von uns geschrieben & designt.

Wenn du gerade Texte abgibst und danach nie wieder siehst, was daraus geworden ist: Hier ist es ungefähr das Gegenteil.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben liegen morgens bereit. Ein Shop braucht einen Sale-Newsletter, der nächste stellt eine neue Kategorie vor. Du liest dich ins Briefing ein, überlegst dir den Aufbau, schreibst Betreffzeile und Text, ziehst dir die Blöcke aus unserem Figma-Designsystem und passt die Grafiken an, teilweise mit KI. Dann geht der Newsletter zur Freigabe an den Kunden und raus.

Du betreust 30 bis 40 Marken. Nach ein paar Wochen weißt du, wie jede einzelne klingt.

Qualifikation

  • Hohe Einsatzbereitschaft: Bei uns wird Vollgas gegeben, 100 % vor Ort mit dem Team in Düsseldorf.
  • Auge für Ästhetik: Du hast ein Auge dafür, was gut aussieht, und traust dich an ein Design-Tool.
  • Extrem schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Neue Tools lernst du in Tagen.
  • Ehrgeiz und Eigenantrieb: Du nimmst Feedback an und wirst mit jeder Woche besser.
  • Du gehst selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools um.
  • Du schreibst gut und schnell. Texte, die verkaufen, nicht Texte, die nur schön klingen.
  • Du willst das ganze Ding verantworten, nicht nur deinen Teil davon.

Figma, Newsletter oder Designausbildung? Kein Muss.

Auge, Tempo und Einstellung entscheiden. Den Rest bringen wir dir bei.

Benefits

  • Kein internes Ping-Pong. Du gibst deinen Text nicht weiter und wartest, was zurückkommt. Du baust den Newsletter selbst zu Ende.
  • Der ganze Newsletter gehört dir: Text, Aufbau, Bildwelt. Du gibst die Richtung vor.
  • Deine Arbeit geht raus. An echte Kunden echter Marken, nicht in eine Ablage. Und du kriegst mit, wie sie gelaufen ist.

  • 3.500 bis 6.000 € im Monat. Ziel jeder Einstellung ist die unbefristete Übernahme.
  • Modernes Büro in Düsseldorf Pempelfort mit Dachterrasse und ÖPNV-Anschluss.
  • Beste Hardware von Apple, höhenverstellbare Tische.
  • Junges Team und Geschäftsführung

  • Urban-Sports-Mitgliedschaft

  • Aktive Arbeit mit modernster KI
  • Monatliche Teamevents

description_html:
IT Security & Compliance Lead – HealthTech (w/m/d)

Berlin Mitte – Hybrid, €70.000 – €100.000 Jahresgehalt, 28 Tage Urlaub

WICHTIG: Wer ausschließlich als Freelancer arbeiten will, ist hier falsch.

Du willst nicht nur Richtlinien schreiben, du willst die komplette Sicherheitsarchitektur in der Cloud bauen und verantworten. Du willst nicht nur Berichte abliefern, du willst Audits von ISO 27001 und BSI‑C5 eigenständig bestehen.

Hier geht es nicht um reine Dokumentation, hier geht es um Hands‑On‑Arbeit mit Terraform, AWS und GCP. Hier geht es nicht um einen starren 9‑to‑5‑Job, hier geht es um eine 32‑Stunden‑Option, Equity und direkten Einfluss auf die Gründer.

Unser Kunde

Ein Berliner HealthTech‑Startup mit rund zehn Mitarbeitenden, das KI‑gestützte Software zur Automatisierung psychotherapeutischer Dokumentation entwickelt. Die Plattform entlastet Therapeuten von administrativen Aufgaben und verbessert die Patientenversorgung. Das Unternehmen positioniert sich als innovativer Anbieter im Schnittfeld von Künstlicher Intelligenz, Gesundheits‑ und Software‑Technologie.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

Hohe Verantwortung – End‑to‑End‑Ownership über Security & Compliance.

Technische Hands‑On‑Arbeit – Cloud‑Security und IaC mit Terraform.

Stabiles Vollzeit‑Umfeld mit 32‑Stunden‑Option.

Equity‑Beteiligung über VESOP.

Direkter Einfluss – täglicher Kontakt zu Gründern und CTO.

Aufgaben

  • Own security & compliance end‑to‑end: Cloud, Produkt und interne IT.
  • Harden und betreibe AWS/GCP‑Umgebungen: IAM, Netzwerk, Verschlüsselung, Logging, Monitoring, Detection.
  • Embed DevSecOps in den SDLC: Threat Modeling, Vulnerability Management, Secure Code Reviews.
  • Leite ISO 27001‑ und BSI‑C5‑Zertifizierungen inkl. Audits, Evidenz‑ und Risikomanagement.
  • Koordiniere Pen‑Tests, Security‑Reviews und Vendor Assessments.
  • Definiere und pflege interne IT‑Baselines: Identity, MDM, Device‑Policies, On‑/Off‑boarding.
  • Biete pragmatische Security‑Guidance und push back bei Architektur‑Entscheidungen.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Hands‑On‑Erfahrung in Cloud‑Security (AWS oder GCP) inkl. Terraform.
  • Vollständige Audit‑Ownership von ISO 27001 / BSI‑C5 inklusive erfolgreicher Zertifizierung.
  • Erfahrung mit DevSecOps, Secure SDLC, Threat Modeling und Vulnerability Management.
  • Fließende Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse (C1).
  • Bachelor‑Abschluss oder gleichwertige Qualifikation.
  • Nachweisbare Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering‑Teams in kleinen, async‑first Umgebungen.

Was hier nicht funktioniert

  • Freelancer – keine langfristige Anstellung.
  • Job‑Hopper – häufige Wechsel (< 2 Jahre) sind ein Dealbreaker.
  • Policy‑Only‑Background – keine technische Hands‑On‑Erfahrung.
  • Fehlende Audit‑Erfahrung (ISO 27001/BSI‑C5) – kein Platz für reine Dokumentationsrollen.
  • Keine Bereitschaft, in Berlin vor Ort zu arbeiten.

Benefits

  • 4,5‑Tag‑Woche bei 28 Tagen Urlaub
  • Firmenwagen zur privaten Nutzung
  • JobRad‑Leasing
  • EGYM Wellpass
  • Geförderte betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Team‑Events und ein inklusives Arbeitsklima
  • Attraktives Gehalt bis zu 100 k €
  • Virtuelle Beteiligung (VESOP)

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Vollständige Ownership über Security & Compliance in einem wachsenden HealthTech‑Startup.
  • Breites Hands‑On‑Spektrum von Cloud‑Hardening bis Audit‑Leitung – steile Lernkurve garantiert.
  • Direkter, täglicher Austausch mit Gründer:innen & CTO ohne Hierarchien.
  • Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche ein Albtraum. Für die Richtigen: genau das, was sie suchen.

Bereit?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt als IT Security & Compliance Lead – HealthTech (w/m/d). Egal ob dein Titel Security Lead, Head of Security oder Security & Compliance Manager heißt: Entscheidend ist, dass du mindestens 5 Jahre Hands‑On‑Erfahrung in Cloud‑Security hast und die komplette ISO 27001/BSI‑C5 Zertifizierung eigenverantwortlich leitest.

Noch Fragen?

08106 – 39 80 370

description_html:
Deine Aufgaben

Als SAP SuccessFactors Consultant (m/w/d) gestaltest du gemeinsam mit uns die sichere SAP-Welt von morgen. Dich erwarten spannende Prüfungs- und Beratungsprojekte rund um moderne SAP-Technologien wie S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, SAP BTP und innovative Security-Lösungen. Wenn du technologische Neugier, Beratungskompetenz und Begeisterung für KI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen mitbringst, bieten wir dir ein Umfeld, in dem du Verantwortung übernehmen, Kunden begeistern und dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln kannst.

Vollzeit (39h/Woche) II Hamburg (Hybrid) oder full-remote
 
Du passt perfekt zu uns, wenn Du Spaß hast,...

  • Unsere Kunden in Security- & Berechtigungsfragen innerhalb der SAP-Welt mit Schwerpunkt in den SuccessFactors Modulen, Concur und SAP HCM zu beraten
  • Dich idealerweise mit Security-Tools wie z.B. SAP Access Control, SAP IAG, One Identity Manager, Pathlock SAST, Xiting XAMS etc. zu befassen
  • mit Hilfe von Generativer KI unsere Produkte und deine Arbeitsabläufe zu verbessern
  • in Prüfungsaufträgen und Beratungsprojekten bei unseren Kunden eine leitende Rolle zu übernehmen
  • interne und externe Workshops zu Themen in HR-Prozessen (Security & Berechtigungen) durchzuführen


Dein Profil

  • du ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mitbringst
  • mehrjährige Kenntnisse im Bereich Human Ressource Cloud Technologien gesammelt hast und dich gut in den SAP SuccessFactors Module Employee Central, Time Management, Recruiting, Onboarding, Learning, Performance & Goals, Succession & Development, Compensation, Analytics auskennst
  • dich idealerweise auch gut mit Concur und externer HR-Software auskennst
  • gerne selbstständig, analytisch und konzeptionell
  • du über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. B2) und gute Englischkenntnisse verfügst


Warum wir?

Wir sind für dich der richtige Arbeitgeber, weil:

  • uns ein familiäres Arbeitsklima wichtig ist
  • wir als Pionier im Bereich SAP Security & Berechtigungsanalysen neue Wege gehen
  • du deine Arbeit auch von zu Hause durchführen kannst
  • dir eine flache Hierarchie wichtig ist
  • wir dir die Möglichkeit geben wollen, dich weiterzuentwickeln
  • wir dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag anbieten

 Du kannst dich außerdem freuen auf:
  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • eine 39h/ Woche
  • Zusatzkrankenversicherung
  • betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • kostenfreier Tiefgaragenstellplatz
  • Kaffee, Wasser und Obst
  • HVV-Fahrkartenzuschuss oder
  • Edenred-Gutschein oder
  • Leasingbike oder
  • EGYM-Wellpass (Sportabo)

title: Software Engineer, Backend (BI Platform)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Deliveroo
description_html:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's growth at scale.

We're looking for a Software Engineer, Backend to join our London team. This role is based in our London office with a hybrid setup, typically 3 days in the office.

Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

 

About the Team

The Core BI team builds and operates the services, integrations and automation that power business intelligence across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. Our platforms help analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers and business teams discover trusted data and make informed decisions at scale.

We combine software engineering, platform ownership, and a strong user focus to make BI tooling reliable, secure, scalable and self-service. The team supports the current BI ecosystem while helping shape a more integrated experience across the DoorDash group.

 

About the Role

As a Software Engineer on the Core BI team, you will build and operate the backend services, APIs and infrastructure our BI platforms run on. This is a hands-on software and platform engineering role: services and integrations, identity and access automation, observability, reliability and developer experience. BI is the domain you serve (primarily Looker and Sigma, and the systems around them), but the problems are backend and platform problems.

You will own problems from discovery through design, implementation, deployment, and operational support. You will work closely with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Product Managers and business teams to turn recurring user needs into durable, self-service capabilities. If you're energized by solving technical problems with data and comfortable being deeply embedded across several domains, this role is for you!

 

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Design, build, test, deploy and operate the backend services, APIs and automation that the BI platforms across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt depend on

  • Automate the platform lifecycle end to end (provisioning, metadata, permissions, migrations, archival and validation) so administration stops being manual work

  • Build the integrations between BI platforms and the wider ecosystem: warehouses, identity providers, orchestration, CI/CD and internal developer tooling

  • Improve the availability, observability, performance, scalability and security of the systems you own, and carry them in production

  • Use AI tooling as part of how you engineer, and where it fits, build LLM-backed capabilities held to the same reliability and governance bar as anything else we ship

  • Raise the engineering bar on the team, from service design and code review to testing, CI/CD and documentation, and improve the developer experience for everyone building on the platform

We're excited about you because…

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend, platform or infrastructure systems

  • Readable, maintainable, well-tested code in Python, plus comfort with SQL and a working understanding of data modelling and warehousing concepts

  • Experience building and owning APIs, integrations or automation in production, with sound judgement on service boundaries, authentication, data contracts and failure modes

  • Hands-on with CI/CD, containers and Kubernetes, observability, debugging and incident response, and you expect to operate what you build

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (LLMs, agentic workflows, AI-assisted development) as part of how you engineer, and judgement about where they help and where they do not

  • End-to-end ownership of ambiguous problems, clear communication with technical and non-technical teams, and comfort self-organising in a fast-paced, distributed environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience owning or integrating with BI platforms such as Looker, Sigma or comparable tools, and familiarity with semantic layers such as LookML or dbt

  • Experience automating identity and access through Okta, SCIM or role-based access controls, or building multi-tenant platforms across brands and regions

  • Experience shipping LLM-backed features to real users (retrieval, grounding and evaluation), or with MCP, agent frameworks or tool-calling in production

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide here to help you feel confident at each stage.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

title: Account Executive (MM/ENT)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Nory
description_html:
Let’s fix hospitality, for good.

Hospitality is tough – margins are thin, waste is high, and teams are stretched. But it doesn’t have to be this hard. That’s why we built Nory.

Our CEO, Conor, knows the pain first-hand. After founding and scaling Mad Egg in Ireland, he got fed up with juggling “market-leading” systems, clunky spreadsheets, and endless printouts. So he set out to build the tool he wished he’d had from day one.

Nory is an all-knowing restaurant management system. It blends real-time data with AI predictive analytics, giving operators control of their margins. From food prep to forecasting, it’s operational intelligence that helps restaurants run with consistency, certainty, and profit. The result? Thriving restaurants, better jobs, less waste, healthier margins.

And we’re just getting started. Fresh off a Series B led by Kinnevik, we’ve grown to 120+ people across Ireland, the UK, and Spain – and demand is scaling faster than we ever imagined.

We’re now looking for an Account Executive (MM/ENT) to join our growing GTM team. In this role, you’ll have the unique opportunity to land and expand the largest hospitality groups in the UK, driving Nory’s ARR growth through high-impact, multi-stakeholder deals.

What you’ll be doing

  • Build and progress a strategic pipeline of mid-market & enterprise hospitality operators.

  • Own the full sales cycle: discovery, demo, multi-stakeholder negotiation, and close.

  • Partner with GTM leadership to shorten cycles and accelerate deal velocity.

  • Position Nory’s platform as the operating system of choice for the largest operators.

  • Land mid-market and enterprise logos, then drive expansion and upsell momentum within accounts.

  • Shape the playbook for how Nory wins in mid-market and enterprise SaaS hospitality sales.

  • Own the journey to shape Nory to be the number 1 platform in your market.

What you’ll bring

  • Proven mid-market and/or enterprise SaaS AE success: consistently hit/exceeded quotas, closed multi-stakeholder deals.

  • Track record selling into hospitality groups, multi-site operators, or adjacent complex verticals.

  • Strong consultative selling skills – you know how to align executive stakeholders on value.

  • High resilience and drive: you thrive in fast, high-pressure, high-impact environments.

  • Clear communicator who builds trust at C-suite level.

  • A bias to action, taking ownership and creating clarity in ambiguity.

Our sales team ethos

We're on a mission to become the most trusted, respected, and impactful sales team in hospitality tech.

A team driven by curiosity, velocity, and a deep commitment to our customers’ success. We will be the team that operators want to buy from and industry leaders want to work with - not just because of what we sell, but because of how we sell.

We will set the standard. We will move with urgency always. We will create lasting value for every prospect we engage with.

What it means to be part of the Nory sales team

Being part of this team means you’re not just in sales – you’re a disruptor, a game changer, a company grower, and a quota crusher. We believe our team will define the top 1% of sales professionals in the hospitality tech industry.

We are:

  • Professionals first. We show up prepared, on time, and ready to raise the standard.

  • Team players. No ego, no politics. We operate as one team.

  • Humble learners. We seek feedback, take it seriously, and act on it fast.

  • Curious operators. We chase clarity. We ask “why” until we get to the truth.

  • Outcome-driven. We commit. We execute. We deliver value.

Sales skills can be taught. Tools can be trained. But if you don’t show up with the right mindset, we can’t help you win.

What you’ll get in return

📈 Meaningful equity, at Nory everyone is an owner!

🌴 35 days of paid leave per year (including bank holidays)

🏥 Comprehensive private health insurance via Axa

🍼 Enhanced parental leave and baby loss support

📚 Learning & development culture – £1000 personal annual budget + quarterly book budget

🖥️ £250 home office workspace budget

🥳 Regular team offsites & socials

📍 Hybrid role with 3 days working from our Holborn office (dog-friendly)

👏 And much more

We hire humans

At Nory, we believe that diverse teams build better products. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and walks of life. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, family status, age, disability, or race. What matters to us is how you think, how you work, and what you bring to the table. Please let us know if you require any adjustments so you can bring your best self to the interview process.

title: Business Analyst
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Transficc
description_html:
Location: Remote-first; office location: Moorgate, London (flexible remote working locations within UK/Europe)
Employment type: Permanent
Working Hours: Full-time (UK 9–6)
Salary: dependent on experience up to £100,000 + Shares + Benefits

As we build more tools used directly by traders, we are looking for a Business Analyst with strong front-office fixed income e-trading experience to help shape what we build and how we build it.

We provide a low-latency, high-throughput distributed messaging system for e-trading fixed income markets. We are, foremost, a technology service provider and support for part of our customers’ trading infrastructure. Our core products involve API connectivity and GUIs for electronic trading.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Leverage your front-office fixed income e-trading experience to help shape trader-facing tools and features.

  • Work with Product and Engineering to turn trading workflows and business problems into clear requirements and deliverable software.

  • Explore workflows including RFQ, pricing, price contribution, venue connectivity, auto-negotiation, hedging, and execution.

  • Identify edge cases, challenge assumptions, and help the team make practical product decisions.

  • Follow features from discovery through development and validation to make sure they solve the intended problem.

To thrive in this role, you need to:

  • Have substantial experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role within a bank, working closely and regularly with one or more trading desks market-making fixed income products electronically.

  • Have experience gathering traders' requirements, working with designers and developers to build UI and API solutions.

  • Know at least one relevant product area in depth, such as Bonds (rates and/or credit) and Interest Rate Swaps.

  • Understand electronic trading workflows, including RFQ, D2C and D2D trading, pricing, venues, and venue connectivity.

  • Be familiar with trading tools and workflows such as auto-negotiation, hedging, and price contribution.

  • Be comfortable working with developers and able to reason through basic logic, algorithms, and pseudocode. You do not need to be a developer.

Bonus points if you:

  • Have knowledge across more than one fixed income product or asset class.

  • Have a formal background as a fixed income trader.

title: Insurance Claims Handler

description_html:
📍 Based in our Lincoln City Centre office 3 days per week with the remaining 2 days working remotely

The Opportunity:

  • Own your claims from start to finish, taking each case from initial submission through to resolution while ensuring accuracy and a great customer experience.

  • Be the point of contact for customers, clearly communicating outcomes and keeping landlords, guarantors, letting agents and tenants informed throughout the journey.

  • Investigate and make informed decisions, reviewing evidence and managing the insurance elements of each claim through to a fair resolution.

  • Find solutions that work for everyone, including overseeing repayment arrangements and helping move complex cases forward.

  • Build strong relationships across Goodlord, working with internal teams and external stakeholders to resolve queries, overcome challenges and keep claims moving.

What we need from you:

  • Experience working in a customer-focused, process-driven environment, where delivering a great customer experience is at the heart of what you do.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to quickly build rapport and trust with customers and stakeholders, both over the phone and in writing.

  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage your own caseload, prioritise effectively and keep on top of service levels.

  • A positive, practical approach, with the ability to stay calm, focused and proactive when working in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong IT skills and confidence using a range of software, ideally including Salesforce and Microsoft packages.

It would be great (but not essential!) if:

  • You have previous experience working in the lettings industry or within an insurance environment.

Our mission:

  • Two in five people in the UK rent their homes. Our mission? To be the gold standard platform for renting

  • We started Goodlord because we wanted to make renting simple and transparent for everyone involved: the agent, the landlord, and the tenant. We knew Generation Rent would lead to more tenants, with higher digital expectations and we were confident we could provide a solution 🏠

  • Like all scale-ups it’s been a bit of a rollercoaster journey, but we’re now stronger than ever, with around 3,000 letting agents using the platform, exciting and varied products and 320 Goodlordians across the group supporting the mission! 💚

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

  • Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

  • Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

  • 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

  • Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

  • Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

What’s next?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

A full job spec is available on request.

Goodlord wants applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life; we are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment.

Creating a space where everyone feels included is central to who we are. Because we're an open book and we learn from each other, we actively champion diverse perspectives and unique life experiences. If there is anything you need to participate fully in the interview process, we'd love to hear about that too - please include it in your application.


** Please note, as we are regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority, all Goodlordians are required to pass a thorough referencing check via Experian before joining the team. We will only ask for references at the point of making an offer.

No agencies please - we have tried and trusted partners we would turn to should we require support.

Two in five people in the UK rent their homes. At Goodlord, our mission is to be the gold standard platform for renting - simplifying complexity across agents, landlords and tenants.

We’re looking for a hands-on Head of Brand Marketing to own how Goodlord shows up in the world - from our brand and content to PR, corporate affairs, thought leadership and the conversations shaping the future of renting.

You’ll be a brilliant brand and communications operator who can set direction while staying close to the work. Someone who enjoys shaping stories, building a distinctive brand, working with the media, developing great content and making sure everything we put into the world feels unmistakably Goodlord.

Reporting directly to our Marketing Director, you’ll lead a talented team of four across content, SEO and design, manage our external PR agency, and work closely with colleagues across Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Sales and the wider business.

You’ll help make Goodlord a distinctive and trusted voice in the rental industry, turning complex topics - from regulation and policy to AI and technology - into stories people actually want to read, hear and talk about. And you’ll make sure our brand doesn’t just look and sound great, but supports our wider commercial goals too.

If you like autonomy, pace and variety - and you’re comfortable being the person who both shapes what great looks like and helps make it happen - this could be a great fit!


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

The pace we move at means no two days are the same, but core responsibilities include:

Brand & storytelling

  • Own and evolve Goodlord’s brand strategy, positioning, identity and voice

  • Make sure our brand shows up consistently and distinctively across everything we do

  • Turn complex topics into clear, engaging stories that resonate with our customers and the wider market

  • Set the bar for great storytelling, creative quality and commercial impact

PR, media & corporate affairs

  • Own our PR and media activity across property, technology and business press

  • Build strong relationships with journalists and identify opportunities for Goodlord to lead and shape relevant conversations

  • Brief and manage our external PR agency, ensuring clear priorities and strong output

  • Lead our approach to corporate affairs, including regulatory and policy-related communications

  • Bring calm, credible judgement to reactive issues and sensitive moments, protecting Goodlord’s reputation while staying true to our voice and values

Content, SEO & thought leadership

  • Set the direction for our content across blogs, opinion pieces, insight-led content, case studies, social and video

  • Lead and develop our content and SEO team, making sure we’re creating useful, engaging work that supports wider marketing and business priorities

  • Shape our thought-leadership agenda around the topics that matter most to Goodlord and our customers - from regulation and compliance to AI, technology and the future of renting

  • Partner with senior leaders on commentary, bylines and external positioning, including ghostwriting and editing where needed

  • Help build the external profiles of our leadership team through media opportunities, speaking engagements, opinion pieces and awards

Creative & design

  • Lead our in-house design team, responsible for customer-facing collateral, tools, campaigns and video

  • Make sure everything we put into the world feels on-brand, well-crafted and commercially sharp

  • Work with the team to turn ideas into brilliant creative execution

Team & commercial impact

  • Lead, support and develop a team of four across content, SEO and design

  • Work closely with Demand Generation, Product Marketing and Sales to make sure brand, PR and content support wider commercial goals

  • Use data and insight to understand what’s working and where we can have greater impact

  • Build strong relationships across Goodlord, bringing together different teams, ideas and priorities to tell better stories

ABOUT YOU

You’ll be well suited to this role if you:

  • Have strong commercial experience across brand, PR/communications and content - in Agency and/or B2B tech, SaaS, fintech, proptech.

  • Have owned a brand, shaping its positioning, messaging, identity and how it shows up in market

  • Have experience directly leading and developing individual contributors across content, creative, design or communications

  • Are a strong storyteller with sound strategic judgement, able to zoom out to brand strategy and zoom in to a single headline

  • Have a track record of building media relationships and delivering coverage across both trade and mainstream press

  • Can translate complex regulation, technology or industry change into engaging, relatable stories

  • Have experience of corporate affairs and reputation or issues management, with the judgement to handle sensitive moments calmly and credibly

  • Are fluent in thought leadership and executive communications - from ghostwriting and bylines to presentations and media commentary

  • Have led and developed people across content, creative, design or communications

  • Understand SEO as a growth channel and know enough to set direction, ask the right questions and challenge specialists

  • Are commercially minded and naturally think about how brand, PR and content can support wider business goals

  • Are collaborative, comfortable working with different stakeholders and happy operating at pace

  • Enjoy having ownership while still being close to the work - you’re happy setting the direction, but equally comfortable rolling your sleeves up when needed

WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT HERE

You’ll have real ownership of how Goodlord shows up in the market

  • You’ll get to work across brand, PR, content and creative rather than being boxed into one discipline

  • You’ll lead a talented team across content, SEO and design

  • You’ll work on genuinely interesting topics at a time of huge change in the rental industry

  • You’ll have plenty of autonomy to turn good ideas into action

  • You’ll be joining a purpose-driven team reshaping one of the UK’s most important industries

  • You’ll be part of a culture that believes in Letting Without Limits - for our customers, our partners and our people

This role is about owning delivery, not building a large function. If you’re looking for a purely strategic communications role with a sizeable team underneath you, this probably isn’t the right fit. If you enjoy being close to the work and making things happen, we’d love to hear from you!

description_html:
What we’re all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us.

The opportunity.

What you’ll be doing

  • Be a functional expert in Quantexa’s platform and products, developing a strong understanding of their capabilities and real-world applications.

  • Develop a strong understanding of Public Sector practices, regulatory environments and customer challenges, and how Quantexa’s platform can address gaps, risks and business needs.

  • Facilitate discovery sessions with customers and partners to uncover core business challenges, technical requirements and desired outcomes.

  • Collaborate with customers, partners and internal teams to design and iterate tailored solutions, ensuring the right approach is defined to address the customer’s needs.

  • Understand key deployment options and enterprise-level decisions, and guide customers and internal teams towards the right solution for the problem.

  • Be an integral part of the account team for selected Public Sector customers, helping to define and execute the account strategy to deliver sustained business value through the use of the Quantexa platform.

  • Work closely with Product, Delivery and Strategic Partners to ensure alignment with customer goals, adherence to Blueprints, effective project scoping and successful value realisation through project and proving stages.

  • Support the successful adoption and operationalisation of the Quantexa platform, ensuring customers are able to embed it effectively within their organisation.

  • Own key executive relationships and ensure appropriate governance, engagement and communication are in place throughout the customer lifecycle.

  • Support successful customer renewals and build the foundations for continued growth and expansion with Quantexa.

What you’ll bring.

  • Customer Focus: Your dedication to understanding customer needs is paramount. You consistently focus on the core challenges at hand, balancing the broader picture with the detail required to deliver meaningful outcomes. You communicate confidently with senior business and technology stakeholders and are comfortable sharing your perspective. You are skilled at helping customers define a strategic roadmap that enables them to realise the value of their Quantexa solutions.

  • Technology Expertise: You will have a strong understanding of data or specialise in one of our key solution domains within the Public Sector, such as data management, financial crime, fraud detection or customer intelligence. You will have experience supporting or delivering platform implementations, understand the challenges customers face, and bring credibility through proven technical and commercial outcomes.

  • Relationship Management: You have experience working directly with clients and a proven ability to build and nurture trusted professional relationships. Customers should see you as a dependable primary point of contact and trusted advisor. You will have strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of engaging effectively with stakeholders and simplifying complex concepts for a range of audiences.

  • Consultative Approach: You have an analytical and structured approach to problem-solving, considering challenges from multiple perspectives. You are collaborative by nature and comfortable working alongside customers and internal teams to identify and implement effective solutions. Experience in a consulting environment would be valuable, with a strong focus on understanding customer needs and delivering measurable value.

  • Teamwork & Collaboration: You are a strong team player who works effectively across Quantexa and with external partners and customers. Building strong relationships and collaborating across teams is fundamental to how we work, and you recognise that we are stronger when we work together.

Minimum Experience and Qualifications

  • Experience in a commercially focused technical role, such as Solution Engineering, Pre-Sales, Technical Sales or Value Consulting.

  • Experience implementing, operating or working with data and technology platforms within the Public Sector.

  • Proven experience defining and executing against a long-term vision, strategy and roadmap.

  • Strong product and technology expertise, with the credibility to engage with customers on complex Public Sector challenges and use cases.

  • Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with senior and executive-level stakeholders.

  • Willingness and ability to travel to customer sites as required.

  • Must be eligible to obtain and maintain SC clearance as a minimum.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realise your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognised and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

     

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

📍 Location: 3 Days Office (London) /2 days hybrid

We are currently seeking an experienced Senior Cost Manager to join our dynamic award winning team. Our client is delivering one of the most complex and high-profile infrastructure programmes in the UK today. Backed by UK Government and key industry stakeholders, the organisation is entering a pivotal phase of development: securing funding, finalising strategic partnerships across the supply chain, and laying the regulatory groundwork to advance into full-scale construction.

As a Senior Cost Manager, you’ll be at the heart of a nationally significant transport programme that will reshape connectivity across the UK. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a landmark infrastructure project from the inside out—driving value, ensuring commercial rigour, and helping deliver one of the most ambitious rail initiatives in British history.

 

About us: CMR is an award winning project controls consultancy that is first and foremost a team of people, passionate about the construction industry and changing the way project controls is provided. Team Leadership & Collaboration

  • Support the Cost Lead in driving integrated cost control practices across the Civil Works Programme.

  • Coach and guide team members within the Cost Discipline

  • Collaborate with other Project Controls disciplines and support functions to ensure aligned project delivery.

Cost Management & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate cost forecasts and actuals within the financial control system (EcoSys).

  • Oversee monthly cost reporting cycles including Actual Cost of Work Performed (ACWP), Earned Value Analysis, and Estimates at Completion (EAC).

  • Ensure all changes are reflected accurately within budgets and forecasts.

  • Review and integrate estimates from Tier 1 contractors and suppliers.

Analysis & Insight

  • Conduct cost performance analysis and identify areas of risk or opportunity.

  • Ensure earned value techniques are correctly implemented across the programme.

  • Support the development and optimisation of cost reporting systems.

 

🔹 We’re looking for:

Essential

  • Demonstrated leadership capability in cost or commercial functions.

  • Deep understanding of cost management methodologies and earned value analysis.

  • Strong grasp of engineering, procurement, and construction processes.

  • High-level analytical and numerical ability with attention to detail.

  • Experience with cost management tools such as EcoSys.

  • Familiarity with NEC or FIDIC contract frameworks.

  • Commercially astute with excellent interpersonal skills.

Desirable

  • Familiarity with scheduling (Primavera P6) and risk tools (ARM).

  • Experience working on complex major infrastructure projects.

  • Ability to communicate and present financial insights to senior stakeholders.

  • Previous experience in the nuclear or regulated infrastructure sector.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree in Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Construction, Accounting or related discipline (or equivalent project experience).

  • Chartered or equivalent professional status preferred.

  • Proven track record in cost management within a major project environment.

• Life Assurance (x4 Salary)

• Pension: employers' contribution of 4%

  • Highways

  • Defence

  • Energy

  • Water and Utilities

  • Support the development and implementation of effective risk management processes across projects and programmes.

  • Produce, maintain and analyse project and programme risk registers.

  • Deliver or support quantitative risk analysis (cost and schedule) where required.

  • Prepare clear and insightful risk reports, dashboards and performance metrics.

  • Identify emerging risks, trends and opportunities, providing practical recommendations to support successful project delivery.

  • Work closely with planning, cost management, PMO and commercial teams as part of an integrated project controls environment.

  • Support project governance by ensuring risk management activities align with client requirements, industry standards and best practice.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of CMR's Risk Management capability, tools and processes.

We're looking for

Essential

  • Demonstrable experience delivering risk management within projects or programmes.

  • Good knowledge of qualitative and quantitative risk management techniques.

  • Experience facilitating risk workshops with project stakeholders.

  • Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to analyse risk information and communicate findings clearly.

  • Professional qualifications in Risk Management, Project Management or Project Controls (e.g. APM, IRM, PMI, MoR or similar).

What we're looking for

About The Alliance

When it comes to building world-class professional communities, The Alliance is leading the way. From Product Marketing and Sales Enablement to Product-Led Growth, AI, Customer Success, and CMOs, we're home to some of the most engaged and influential communities in the industry.

With 160,000+ professionals across our communities and a constant stream of content, courses, events, and memberships, we help our members learn, connect, and grow. Our executive events are a key part of that mission—bringing together senior leaders to share insights, tackle industry challenges, and build meaningful relationships.

Every year, we engage attendees, speakers, partners, and members from some of the world's leading organisations and fastest-growing start-ups, including TikTok, Microsoft, Peloton, and Uber.

 

The Role

We are on look out for a detail-driven, proactive Customer Support Executive to join our vibrant Customer Success team. In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact across our support channels, elevating the overall member experience by resolving queries and ensuring our users maximize the value of our platform.
Beyond day-to-day support, you will spearhead forward-looking initiatives designed to preemptively address customer needs, such as optimizing our AI support agent, analyzing key pain points, and building expertise in customer operations within a fast-growing, collaborative environment.

Responsibilities

  • Customer Support Champion: Be the first line of contact for our members via email and our ticketing system, providing timely, friendly, and helpful responses every day.

  • Escalation Pro: Spot the difference between a quick fix and something that needs a deeper dive, escalating where appropriate to keep things moving smoothly.

  • Priority Pro: Keep a clear head and a clean inbox, staying organised across multiple tickets, deadlines, and internal priorities.

  • AI Agent Champion: Support the ongoing maintenance, development, and continuous improvement of our AI agent, helping to refine its responses, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure it continues to deliver a great experience for our members when we’re not around.

  • Internal Collaborator: Work closely with Customer Success, Education, Product and other departments to resolve member issues quickly and efficiently.

  • Process Improver: Contribute to FAQs, support documentation, and internal feedback loops to make us even better, every day.

  • Platform Power User: Use Intercom to manage tickets and feed back customer experience improvements to the wider team.

Compensation: £32,000-34,000 base Salary (depending on experience)

Location: this role can be Remote from wherever in the UK or hybrid in our London office.

This role is for you if you:

  • Have excellent written communication skills and a calm, customer-first approach.

  • Have experience with Intercom, Zendesk or similar support platforms (ideally including experience working with AI agents)

  • Are forward thinking, detail-oriented and take pride in getting the small things right.

  • Know when to escalate, and when to troubleshoot.

  • Strong communicator - from our customers to your colleagues, you’ll be working very closely with lots of people.

  • Team player - success doesn’t happen in a vacuum, we need everyone in the org to be rallied around the same goals and helping each other out to achieve them.

  • Creative problem-solver - we know that processes can always be improved. We’re looking for someone who can think on their feet, solve problems, and identify opportunities.

  • Tech-savvy - we lean on lots of different apps and while we’ll obviously onboard you on each, we’re looking for a quick learner who can show us a thing or two. We’re especially interested in your experience with Customer Support AI and Knowledge Database management.

 

Benefits: We believe exceptional people deserve exceptional support.

Time Off:

  • 34 days' annual leave, including UK Bank Holidays.

  • Your birthday is off every year.

 

Health & Wellbeing:

  • Enhanced family policies.

  • Private Medical Insurance.

  • Life Insurance (4x salary).

  • On-demand therapy, coaching, and mental fitness support through Oliva.

  • Heavily subsidised gym membership via Wellness Hub.

  • Cycle to Work and Workplace Nursery schemes.

 

Flexibility:

  • Flexible working hours, allowing you to work when you are most productive.

  • Monthly allowance via ThanksBen (£600 annually in year one, increasing with tenure).

 

Learning & Development:

  • Personal L&D budget (£500 annually in year one, increasing with tenure).

  • Four paid Learning & Development or Volunteer Days each year.

  • Team training and development opportunities.

 

Equipment & Culture

  • New tech setup including laptop, screen, mouse, and keyboard.

  • Company social events.

  • A collaborative, ambitious, and supportive working environment.

 

Community & Inclusion

At The Alliance, we're committed to creating a workplace that is free from discrimination and bias, where everyone has equal opportunities to succeed and contribute.

We know our work here is never done, and we continue to strive for a more inclusive environment every day.

 

If you're worried you don't meet every requirement listed, don't let that stop you from applying. Unique backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are essential to our ability to innovate and grow, so if you think you'd be a great fit, we'd love to hear from you.

 

We are The Alliance—in more ways than one.

TL;DR - You’ll execute Lovable’s lifecycle marketing for the self-serve base - activation, engagement, retention, and reactivation. Hands-on, AI-first, and increasingly driven by intelligent personalization. You’ll shape how millions of builders experience Lovable every day.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years in B2C lifecycle, CRM, or growth marketing at consumer or PLG scale

  • 3+ years of deep, hands-on expertise with a modern lifecycle marketing platform like Braze, Iterable, or Customer.io

  • Fluency in Liquid templating and email HTML/CSS, segmentation logic, and event-driven campaign architecture, experience with CDPs, event pipelines (e.g., RudderStack) and SQL for self-serve analysis makes you even stronger here

  • Experience building adaptive, evolving lifecycle systems, not just static journeys

  • Hands-on experience applying AI and automation to content creation, personalization, segmentation, and decisioning logic

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and designing systems that improve over time

  • Content craftsmanship to ensure content going out always builds on Lovable’s brand

What you’ll do

  • Operate lifecycle marketing for the self-serve base across activation, engagement, retention, and reactivation.

  • Lifecycle PoC for product launches, experiments, and GTM moments

  • Design intelligent, rules-based or algorithmic lifecycle programs that dynamically decide who to message, when to reach them, which channel to use (email, inbox, push, and emerging CRM channels), and what content to send, based on behavior and context

  • Work AI-first across your entire workflow, applying AI and automation to content generation, personalization, segmentation, decisioning, and analysis

  • Build experimentation and data-driven optimization into every lifecycle program, measuring true incremental impact rather than surface-level engagement

  • Partner closely with Data, Product, and GTM teams so lifecycle messaging feels native, timely, and valuable

What Success Looks like

  • Increased lift from lifecycle marketing you’re working on vs baseline

  • Builders experience Lovable’s lifecycle messaging as remarkably relevant, well-timed, and valuable - not noisy or generic

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

This is an IC role for someone senior who likes being in the detail and building the machine, not just operating it.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years running paid search and paid social. You've owned significant budgets across Google and Meta, you know your way around Microsoft Ads, and you've worked in at least one DSP (DV360, Criteo, or The Trade Desk).

  • Automation-led. You don't do by hand what a script or an agent could do. You've built automations for reporting, budget pacing, or optimisation, and you're comfortable with platform APIs and pulling your own data.

  • A social-creative scaler. You understand social scales on creative, and you can keep a diversified asset pipeline moving with the creative team. You've taken a paid social channel from small to large and kept it efficient on the way up.

  • Efficiency-minded. You think in CAC and payback, and you can tell efficient growth from spend that just looks like growth.

  • Hands-on by choice. You'd rather be in the account driving impact than in a deck. You like the detail, and you build things yourself.

  • Already building with AI. You use AI day to day, you're comfortable building agents, and you'll use Lovable to ship the tools this role runs on.

  • Technical spiking. You go deep in at least one of: data analytics, data engineering, or tracking and measurement. You don't need all three at that level, but you need to be strong in one, comfortable in the rest, and delivering the work yourself.

What you’ll do

  • Run paid search and paid social end to end. Own the channels across Google, Microsoft, Meta, and emerging AI surfaces like ChatGPT. You set the account structure, the bids, the budgets, and the targets.

  • Automate the day-to-day. Build agents and automations with Lovable that read performance, pace and shift budgets, flag issues before they cost us, and make the changes. The goal is a paid program that mostly runs itself, with you steering.

  • Scale paid social through creative. Keep a steady supply of diversified assets in market, and know which creative to push when. You've scaled social before, so you know volume and variety are what keep it working.

  • Go programmatic where it pays. Use a DSP (DV360, Criteo, or The Trade Desk) to extend into prospecting, retargeting, and new inventory, and hold the same efficiency bar there as everywhere else.

  • Protect the signal. This is where your technical depth shows up, and you deliver it yourself rather than handing it to a data team. Build and debug the tracking (server-side/CAPI, pixels, cookies, consent, and deduplication), and write the queries that judge channels on incrementality instead of platform-reported ROAS alone.

  • Stay in the details. You'll be in the accounts, running tests on audiences, bids, and creative, and building most of this yourself. This is a role for someone who wants their hands on the work.

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.
