title: Senior Product Developer – Candy & Confectionery (All Genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Ahead Gmbh
description_html:
YOU & AHEAD

At ahead, we are on a mission to clean up the world’s candy drawers. We make the snacks everyone actually craves: chocolate bars, protein bars, wafers, cookies, gummies and more. Our products contain up to 90% less sugar with zero compromise on taste. We are a 130-person team based in Hamburg, with our own lab, a portfolio of more than 170 SKUs and ambitious growth plans across D2C, retail, Amazon and Europe.

We are looking for a Senior Product Developer for Candy & Confectionery to own the technical development of our portfolio from the first brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up and launch.

As our Senior Product Developer, you will bring technical depth to one of our most important categories and make sure every decision works in the real world: in the recipe, in the factory and in the customer’s hands.

Are you a food developer who knows how to turn a great idea into a product people genuinely love? Someone who can balance taste, texture, stability, cost, compliance and timing while getting the product over the line? If you like taking ownership and enjoy solving real product problems, we would love to hear from you! 


YOUR TASKS

  • End-to-End Product Development: You own candy and confectionery projects from brief to launch. You translate requirements into clear technical targets, develop and optimise formulations, oversee trials, sensory validation and technical decisions.

  • Sugar Reduction & Product Performance: You develop reduced-sugar and no-added-sugar products without compromising on taste. You understand how ingredients affect texture, processing, stability and shelf life, and make clear trade-offs between quality, cost, compliance and speed.

  • Sensory, Shelf Life & Scale-Up: You plan and coordinate sensory, shelf-life and stability testing. You prepare for pilot and industrial trials, work closely with co-manufacturers, troubleshoot issues and follow solutions through to production.

  • Specifications, Suppliers & Compliance: You manage formulations, specifications, technical documentation, ingredients and samples. Together with our Quality team, you ensure that food law, labelling, allergen, nutritional and claims requirements are considered from the start.

  • Cross-Functional Ownership: You work closely with Product, Quality, Operations, Procurement, Brand, Retail and Marketing. You communicate clearly, flag risks early, challenge assumptions and keep projects moving.

  • Building Better NPD Processes: You document decisions and learnings, create clear handovers and help make product development more structured and predictable as ahead grows.


YOUR PROFILE

  • You bring 5+ years of experience in food product development, R&D, or NPD, with a track record from brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up, and launch. Hands-on experience in gummies, candy, chocolate, confectionery, or a related sweet-goods category is mandatory.

  • You understand how taste, texture, processing, stability, shelf life, ingredients and production realities come together in a successful product. You have experience with sugar-reduction or no-added-sugar systems and know how to balance product performance with consumer expectations.

  • You have worked with ingredient suppliers and co-manufacturers and have been involved in pilot or industrial-scale production. You are comfortable with specifications, technical documentation, and food-law requirements.

  • You take ownership and follow through. You are structured without being bureaucratic, comfortable with ambiguity and willing to challenge a brief, assumption or timeline when needed. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and enjoy working as a senior individual contributor without direct reports initially.

  • You hold a degree or equivalent training in food science, food technology, chemistry, nutrition science, ecotrophology, or a comparable field. You communicate confidently in German and English.


WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE

  • Experience launching 10+ food products, ideally across multiple markets.

  • Experience working with gummies, candy, chocolate bars, cookies, filled confectionery or similar products.

  • Strong knowledge of sugar reduction, sweetener systems, fibres and texture management.

  • Experience planning, conducting or interpreting sensory tests, shelf-life studies and stability testing.

  • Background in better-for-you food, functional food, private-label NPD, or a fast-growing consumer brand.

  • Experience delivering products into D2C and retail channels across DACH or Europe.


AND WHY AHEAD?

Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together.

  • Hypergrowth Environment: If you're looking for greenfield, creative freedom, and real impact, you're in the right place. We're a team that is scaling fast - with purpose
  • Great Workspace: A central office in the heart of Hamburg near the Alster, top equipment (MacBook), snacks, drinks, plenty of ahead products - and yes, a ping-pong table. We’re also pet-friendly, so you can always bring your furry friend along
  • Amazing Team: Young, international, ambitious - inspiring colleagues who collaborate, support each other, and genuinely enjoy working together
  • Career Growth: Develop through cross-functional projects, structured feedback cycles, and a steep learning curve in a dynamic, high growth environment. We offer a fair, attractive salary with role-dependent bonus opportunities
  • Great Benefits: Fuel yourself with ahead snacks, drinks, and merch - we’ve got you covered. On top: a €50 monthly allowance to spend as you like - Urban Sports Club, mobility options, or vouchers from your favorite brands (IKEA, Rewe, Rossmann and more)
  • Vacation Days: Enjoy 28 vacation days plus two extra days off on December 24 (Christmas Eve) and December 31 (New Year’s Eve)
  • Events & Offsites: Regular after-work hangouts and legendary annual team offsites you won’t forget
This role is based in Hamburg, with the flexibility of up to 2 home office days per week and the option to work from abroad for agreed upon periods. If this resonates with you, we're excited to go ahead with you!

title: Applied AI Scientist(m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Nc Group
description_html:
About us

NET CHECK GmbH was founded in 1999 with the aim of improving the quality of communication networks. Since then, NET CHECK has developed into the leading partner of network operators and infrastructure providers of mobile and fixed networks of all technologies. Its core competencies include international network benchmarking (comparative measurements) as well as network planning and fault analysis. NET CHECK has one of Germany's largest crowdsourcing platforms, which generates over 144 million data points every day. Our commitment to quality and security has earned us the trust of scientific and government institutions.
NET CHECK is headquartered in Berlin and is part of the NC GROUP, an owner-managed group of companies with a total of over 180 employees at five locations in Germany and one in Belgrade, Serbia. 

Job Summary: We build AI platforms that transform complex telecom network data—including drive tests, voice quality, broadband diagnostics, and signaling analysis—into clear, actionable insights.
We are looking for an Applied AI Scientist who combines strong analytical thinking with practical engineering skills. You will model complex problems, develop and prototype ML and agentic AI solutions, and turn them into reliable, production-ready tools for real users while applying the latest developments in AI.


Responsibilities

  • Design and build agentic AI systems and RAG pipelines that can reason over technical documentation and live network data.
  • Take ownership of testing and evaluation by developing evaluation datasets, metrics, and benchmarks for accuracy, retrieval quality, latency, and cost. Ensure system quality can be measured reliably and regressions are identified before reaching users.
  • Develop and continuously improve our evaluation and observability practices, including offline and online evaluations, LLM-as-a-judge approaches where appropriate, regression testing, and quality dashboards for agentic AI and RAG systems.

About

Chrono24 is the world’s leading online marketplace for luxury watches. Driven by a passion for timepieces and technology, we connect buyers and sellers from across the globe. Our goal is to maximise trust and transparency in the watch market.

About

Growth Operations is the engine room of Chrono24’s commercial execution - connecting Marketing, Supply, and VIP Sales with the analytical rigour and operational structure they need to make faster, better decisions. As Senior GTM Strategy Manager, you will be the analytical and operational backbone of the team, reporting to the Chief of Staff and working directly with Growth leadership - and, where relevant, the broader executive leadership - on the commercial questions that most directly determine our growth trajectory. We use AI tools as a matter of course, not an occasional shortcut. We expect this role to use them to compress the time between question, insight, and decision, and to help raise the standard across the team of what good, AI-enabled work looks like.


What you can expect

  • Own research, modelling, and problem-structuring on high-priority strategic questions (e.g. C2C strategy, new go-to-market motions), building scenario analyses rigorous enough to inform decisions and clear enough to present to executive leadership, using AI tools to move faster and think more rigorously.
  • Take cross-functional initiatives from framing through to delivery - including the messy middle of stakeholder coordination, dependency management, and keeping things moving; synthesise inputs into decision-ready recommendations and bring your own point of view rather than presenting options neutrally.
  • Design and maintain Growth’s internal KPI and performance reporting, working with the Data and BI teams to ensure the right metrics are tracked, defined consistently, and surfaced at the right cadence.
  • Identify performance trends, risks, and opportunities across our Marketplace and VIP go-to-market motions, and turn complex data into clear narratives for leadership discussions.
  • Own recurring analytical deliverables, including weekly and monthly performance summaries for the Growth leadership team.
  • Act as a thought partner on high-priority strategic initiatives such as US market acceleration and new go-to-market motions (e.g. CPO, certification, consignment).


What sets you apart

  • 5+ years in strategy consulting, investment banking, or a GTM / strategy / business operations role at a top-tier, high-growth technology company.
  • You’ve owned outcomes, not just workstreams: as comfortable driving a cross-functional initiative to completion as building the model that justified it.
  • Strong analytical skills: able to build a model, stress-test assumptions, and know when the numbers are telling you something real versus something convenient; you understand what they mean, not just what they say.
  • Fluent with AI tools: you use LLMs, research agents, and analytical co-pilots as a natural part of how you work, and you’re thoughtful about where they help and where human judgment still leads.
  • Commercial instinct and good judgment about where to invest effort; able to communicate findings clearly to senior stakeholders and make structure where there isn’t any.
  • Demonstrated interest in ecommerce and marketplaces; knowledge of luxury resale or the watch market is a plus. Fluent in English; German is a plus.


What we offer

  • A dynamic and international work environment.
  • The opportunity to contribute significantly to the expansion and success of our company.
  • Attractive compensation and development opportunities.

Whether for your sports programme, as a daycare allowance or as a flexible mobility budget, with an additional monthly budget of €80 per person, you can use the benefits individually and design them according to your wishes!
  • Permanent contract: With a permanent contract, we offer you security and perspective in your career. We focus on long-term collaboration and your growth!

Diversity is our strength.
At Chrono24, we embrace diversity because we believe it enriches not only our corporate culture but also our success. Be yourself – and let’s achieve great things together!

About

Chrono24 is the world's leading marketplace for luxury watches, bringing together watch enthusiasts, collectors, dealers, and buyers from all over the world every day. As a Senior Controller, you'll be part of our Controlling team and actively help shape Chrono24's financial steering. title: Senior Process Engieer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Tozero
description_html:
ABOUT US

tozero is Europe’s leading deep-tech startup specializing in the recycling of
lithium-ion batteries. Committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming
the material life cycle, we’re actively crafting sustainable recycling solutions for a
cleaner and more innovative future.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the
design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes.
This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering,
and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into
robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our
future plants are built on solid fundamentals.
Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite
and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external
engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with:
a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development.
We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production
environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is
telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales.


WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

Must Have's:
1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up
● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants.
● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process
descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions.

● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design
criteria and scale-up assumptions.
● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future
plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than
theoretical assumptions alone.
2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization
● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps.
● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of
graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing.
● Identify the parameters controlling yield, purity and process stability and
translate these insights into concrete process improvements.
● Work closely with R&D and Operations while maintaining a strong focus on
process performance and technology development rather than daily
troubleshooting.
3. Data Analysis & Process Modeling
● Turn plant data into engineering decisions.
● Evaluate operational and experimental data, build and validate mass balances
and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process
performance.
● Define what data needs to be collected to support future scale-up decisions.
● Technically guide data analysts and other engineering functions to ensure
that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality.
● Translate analysis into clear recommendations for process upgrades and
future plant designs.
4. Commissioning & Process Validation
● Make sure what we designed actually works.
● Participate in FATs/SATs, commissioning activities and process performance
validation for new equipment and plant expansions.
● Develop acceptance and process validation criteria based on the original
design intent.
● Evaluate commissioning and operational data to confirm that installed
systems achieve their calculated performance targets.
● Work closely with Operations during handover while ensuring clear ownership
transfers once the process meets its design criteria.
5. Operational Readiness, Process Safety & SOPs
● Design processes that can be operated safely and consistently.
● Translate process design and engineering intent into clear Standard Operating
Procedures (SOPs), operating envelopes and process documentation.
● Participate actively in HAZOPs, LOPAs, and other process safety reviews,
ensuring that process risks are identified and addressed during design rather
than after installation.
● Support Operations in understanding the design basis and critical process
parameters of newly commissioned systems.

Nice-to-have's:
Vendor & EPC Coordination
● Represent tozero's process requirements with external engineering partners
and equipment suppliers.
● Prepare and review technical specifications, vendor proposals and engineering
documentation.
● Challenge unsupported assumptions, identify over-engineered solutions and
ensure equipment is correctly sized for our process.
● Support technical bid evaluations and equipment selection, balancing process
performance, CAPEX, operability and scalability.
● Act as a strong technical counterpart to EPCs, engineering contractors and
equipment vendors throughout project execution.


Your profile

You have a strong chemical/process engineering foundation and enjoy solving
technically complex problems with a combination of first-principles engineering and
real plant data.
● Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Metallurgical
Engineering or a related technical field.
● Ideally 5+ years of experience in process engineering within the chemical,
hydrometallurgy, battery, mining, minerals, recycling or related process
industries; specific expertise in graphite and lithium extraction and
post-processing is highly preferred.
● Strong experience with process design and scale-up, including PFDs, P&IDs,
mass/energy balances and equipment sizing.
● Comfortable working with industrial datasets and translating operational data
into engineering models and decisions.
● Experience with solid-liquid separation, precipitation, flotation,
hydrometallurgy or mineral processing is highly valuable.
● Able to critically review vendor proposals and confidently challenge technical
assumptions.
● Strong experience supporting commissioning and process validation of
industrial equipment or plants.
● Familiarity with process safety methodologies such as HAZOP and LOPA.
● Comfortable moving between detailed calculations, engineering
documentation and the actual plant.
● Strong communicator who can work effectively across R&D, Engineering,
Operations, suppliers and EPC partners.
● Fluent English; German is a plus.


Why us?

Our technology is moving from first-of-a-kind industrial operations toward
increasingly larger and more standardized plants.
The Senior Process Engineer will help us make that transition successfully: turning
what we learn from today's plant into the engineering basis for tomorrow's plants
while supporting commissioning and ramping up efforts.
You will directly influence process performance, equipment selection, CAPEX and the
technical architecture of our future facilities — helping ensure that every new scale is
safer, simpler, more efficient and better engineered than the one before it.

As a Working Student (d/f/m) in our Invoicing Team, you will join us at the earliest possible date and support us with reviewing carrier invoices, contributing to efficient and reliable billing processes. You will be part of an international team of seven colleagues, based across Hamburg, Naarden, Nantes, and Madrid.

You can look forward to a working environment where mutual support, team spirit, and positive collaboration are at the heart of how we work.

  • You are responsible for reviewing and checking carrier invoices across different brands and countries.

Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.
  • Obsessed with quality.
  • Deliberate in our decisions.
  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

As a Solutions Engineer at Sonar, you’ll play a central role in providing deep technical expertise to our prospects and supporting them in evaluating our solution. The SE team works as part of the Sales process and also engages with Marketing, Product Management, and Development teams to provide feedback on our products' evolution and messaging.

What you will do daily
  • Help prospective customers understand how our AC/DC approach fits within their software development life cycle
  • Drive technical aspects of pre-sales business opportunities by doing technical presentations and demonstrations and supporting product evaluations 
  • Advise customers on the best alignment of the Sonar solution with their favored deployment strategy
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical problems encountered by prospective customers evaluating our products
  • Go beyond the sale to ensure successful product adoption and growth following purchase, working with our Customer Success and Support teams
  • Help existing customers understand the additional capabilities of advanced product editions
  • Provide technical enablement to channel partners to raise their level of service

    • Experience and qualifications
  • Some practical experience in software development or DevOps engineering highly desirable
  • Familiarity of both local and cloud-based software deployment platforms and technologies, including Linux, Windows, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure
  • Passion for technology and successful customer outcomes
  • Ability to dive into complex technical problems, perform troubleshooting, develop solutions, and articulate them in verbal and written form
  • Proven ability to work in a team, receiving and giving feedback as well as sharing knowledge
  • A can-do attitude: challenging the status quo, leading and contributing to key improvements and innovations
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent English, verbal/written communication skills
  • German language is desirable but not a hard requirement.

description_html:
At PPRO, we simplify access to local payments - providing a local payments platform that empowers giants like PayPal, Stripe, and Microsoft to connect with billions of consumers worldwide. We are on an ambitious, fast-paced mission to 3x our growth by 2028 - and we’re just getting started.

Our magic lies in our team of proud payments nerds. Spanning over 50 nationalities across 10+ global locations, our diverse cultures aren't a checklist; they are the competitive advantage driving our innovation. This is a people-first, high trust environment where you’ll have the autonomy to make a massive impact, own your work end-to-end, and grow through broad exposure, meaningful challenges, and continuous learning. We get things done, challenge respectfully, put the customer first, and recognise that our biggest successes are those we create as a team. If you’re ready to leave your footprint on global commerce, join us.
 
The Purpose:

At PPRO, Senior Software Engineers make some of the most significant decisions for the company. Think of yourself as an important contributor to the success of your team, with a significant impact on the team’s product, but also on its culture and spirit. You will solve complex technical problems, participate in decisions on architecture and technical direction, support and mentor other engineers and work alongside them in the code.

What you’ll do
  • Own products and services end-to-end — backend and UI — including architecting solutions that turn risk into a product, such as our customer
  • facing disputes and chargebacks platform
  • Collaborate and grow in a dynamic and autonomous environment, working to define undefined boundaries in disputes and chargebacks across payment methods
  • Be an integral part of a team, in addition to its culture and ways of working.
  • Common practices include agile methodologies, pair and mob programming
  • Use the latest technologies to solve real problems for our customers at a massive scale
  • Be part of a team that will take full operational responsibility for the services that you own, ensuring security compliance (GDPR) and potentially taking part in an on-call rotation.
  • Share your knowledge and build creative solutions while helping the team evolve best practices

    • What we look for in you
  • Results-orientation, collaborative, pragmatic, and with a continuous improvement mindset
  • Multiple experiences working with Java and Spring Boot 
  • Experience designing and building scalable products and services
  • Experience with the cloud (preferably AWS) and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform)
  • Experience or a strong interest in the complexities of Disputes or Chargebacks
  • Comfortable making UI changes in React; full stack experience is desirable
  • Great problem solving abilities and the ability to articulate tradeoffs of technical problems to a broad audience 
  • Working proficiency in English

    • Some of the technologies you’ll get to work with:
  • Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
  • AWS Cloud components such as EKS, DynamoDB, Kinesis and OpenSearch.
  • Event-driven architectures
  • React, TypeScript
    • What's in it for you?
     
    Hybrid working - We offer a hybrid structure with a 3 days / week on site expectation, so you can strike the balance between office and home working. In addition to our 30-day holiday allowance, we also provide a work from abroad policy, enabling employees to work remotely for up to another 30 days per year.
     
    Learning and Development - We offer a €1,000 annual budget to support your professional growth—because investing in your development benefits us all. In addition, we provide leadership cafés, on-the-job training, and other opportunities to help you grow your skills and thrive in your role.
     
    Insurance - Because better safe than sorry - we want our employees to benefit from various insurances including accident insurance, disability insurance, direct insurance (bAV) and travel insurance. 
     
    Gym membership - PPRO helps contribute towards the costs of your gym membership, supporting your physical fitness journey while easing the burden on your wallet
     
    Enhance Family Leave - We understand the importance of family - that's why we offer enhanced family leave to support you during key life moments.
     
     
    Mental Health Platform - We’ve teamed up with a top well-being platform to provide one-on-one therapy, chat therapy, therapist-led courses, guided meditations, and more.
     
    Pet-friendly office - Because work is better with your paw-tners by your side
     
     
    Our Principles: 
     
    We get things done: We are courageous; we take ownership, make decisions and get things done.
     
    We act with trust and integrity: We listen first and challenge respectfully. We seek out and leverage diverse perspectives. We welcome and offer honest and open feedback, always assuming positive intent
     
    We put the customer first: We are laser focused on delivering outstanding outcomes for our customers. We put the customer at the heart of what we do.
     
    We make things better: We boldly explore  new ideas and have an unwavering commitment to continuous improvement.
     
    We work as a team: We collaborate closely and value team success over individual achievement.

title: Operations Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Heidi Systems
description_html:
Heidi Systems baut das Energy-OS für Real Estate. Dafür digitalisieren wir einen der letzten großen analogen Märkte Europas und schaffen die Infrastruktur für intelligentes Energiemanagement in Gebäuden.

Wo wir stehen

  • 8 Personen
  • Starke Pipeline mit +5.000 aktiven Deals
  • Angel-Runde mit Unicorn-Foundern sowie Directors von Google und OpenAI
  • Auf dem Weg zu 10x in 2026

Wir rollen die Messdienstbranche neu auf – einen riesigen, verstaubten Markt, den seit Jahrzehnten kaum jemand angefasst hat. Als Prop- und ClimateTech verbinden wir Software, IoT und Operations zu einer Plattform, die Energie- und Verbrauchsdaten erstmals durchgängig digital, transparent und in Echtzeit verfügbar macht.

Wir wachsen stark und suchen jemanden, der unsere operativen Abläufe mit aufbaut, übernimmt und kontinuierlich besser macht.

Als Operations Manager bist du für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung unserer Kundenprojekte verantwortlich. Du sorgst dafür, dass aus einem gewonnenen Auftrag ein sauber umgesetztes Projekt wird – von der ersten Abstimmung über die Koordination aller Beteiligten bis zur erfolgreichen Übergabe und laufenden Betreuung.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Founder und dem gesamten Team zusammen, übernimmst vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung und hast dabei viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Die Rolle ist ausdrücklich nicht als klassische Verwaltungsposition gedacht: Du ownst deine Themen und sorgst dafür, dass sie umgesetzt werden.

Aufgaben

Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst End-to-End Ownership für eigene Kunden und Objekte – vom Onboarding bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung
  • Du koordinierst Hausverwaltungen, Eigentümer, Installateure, Mieter und weitere Partner und sorgst dafür, dass alle Beteiligten zur richtigen Zeit die richtigen Informationen haben
  • Du behältst jederzeit den Überblick über deine Projekte: Was ist erledigt? Was fehlt? Wer wartet auf wen? Was muss als Nächstes passieren?
  • Du bist Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden und Partner und sorgst für eine klare, schnelle und verlässliche Kommunikation
  • Du identifizierst manuelle und repetitive Abläufe und entwickelst daraus bessere Prozesse und Systeme
  • Du automatisierst operative Abläufe mit No-Code- und Low-Code-Tools, z. B. n8n oder Claude Code
  • Du baust interne Strukturen für Projekttracking, Dokumentation und Reporting auf und stellst sicher, dass diese im Alltag tatsächlich genutzt werden
  • Du analysierst operative Kennzahlen, erkennst Engpässe und leitest konkrete Verbesserungen ab
  • Du entwickelst unsere Operations gemeinsam mit dem Founder weiter und übernimmst mit wachsender Verantwortung größere operative Bereiche
  • Du treibst eigene Projekte und Initiativen von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung und misst, ob sie tatsächlich etwas verbessern

Qualifikation

Qualifikation

  • Laufendes oder abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium, z. B. in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Immobilienwirtschaft oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich – alternativ vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung
  • Idealerweise erste Erfahrung in Operations, Projektmanagement, Consulting, einem Startup, Real Estate oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld ist ein Plus
  • Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand sagt, was als Nächstes zu tun ist
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Themen den Überblick
  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten – du kannst klar und verbindlich mit Kunden, Hausverwaltungen, Installateuren und Partnern kommunizieren und unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenbringen
  • Du gehst Probleme pragmatisch an und findest Lösungen, statt sie weiterzugeben
  • Starke analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Zahlen und Prozesse
  • Du hast Spaß daran, Dinge selbst aufzubauen und bestehende Abläufe kritisch zu hinterfragen
  • Technikaffinität und Interesse an AI, SaaS, IoT oder Automatisierung sind ein Plus
  • Du fühlst dich in einem schnellen Early-Stage-Startup wohl und kannst mit Unklarheit und wechselnden Prioritäten umgehen
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau (nicht verhandelbar) sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

Benefits

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit und tägliches Mentoring durch einen erfahrenen Gründer und eine extrem steile Lernkurve
  • Teil eines stark wachsenden Early-Stage-Startups zu werden, das einen riesigen Markt digitalisiert – mit viel Eigenverantwortung, hoher Geschwindigkeit und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Echte End-to-End-Verantwortung: Deine Projekte gehören dir – von der ersten Abstimmung bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung
  • Die Chance, unsere Operations von Anfang an mit aufzubauen und die Prozesse eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens maßgeblich zu prägen
  • Die Möglichkeit, mit wachsender Verantwortung größere operative Bereiche und perspektivisch ein eigenes Team zu übernehmen
  • Zugang zu einem starken Netzwerk in Immobilien, Tech, Energie und Venture Capital
  • Ein High-Performance-Team in einer humorvollen und unterstützenden Kultur, mit regelmäßigen Team-Dinnern und gemeinsamen Events
  • Ein neu renoviertes Altbau-Office in Berlin Mitte direkt am Monbijoupark, gemeinsames Arbeiten an einem Tisch, kurze Wege und direkte Entscheidungen

title: Staff/Principal Product Manager, Patient Experience
description_html:
Job Title: Staff/Principal Product Manager, Patient Experience

Location: Remote, USA

About the Company

Wheel is evolving the traditional care ecosystem by equipping the nation's most innovative companies with a premier platform to deliver high-quality virtual care at scale. We offer proven strategies and cutting-edge technologies to foster consumer engagement, build brand loyalty, and maximize return on investment. Wheel solutions include configurable virtual care programs, an intuitive consumer interface, and access to a nationwide network of board-certified clinicians. Discover how Wheel is transforming the future of healthcare by visiting www.wheel.com.

About the Role

As a Staff/Principal Product Manager, Patient Experience at Wheel, you will own the strategy and roadmap behind the consumer-facing experience that patients use to access care through our enterprise partners. This is a B2B2C role: our patients interact with Wheel through partner brands, so you'll need to design experiences that satisfy a consumer's expectations for a modern healthcare product while also meeting the technical, brand, and compliance requirements of large enterprise partners.

You'll operate at a systems level, connecting patient-facing experience decisions to the underlying clinical, operational, and platform architecture that makes those experiences possible. You bring real hands-on experience shaping AI-powered product, not just using AI tools in your own workflow. This is a builder role for a senior product leader who can set a multi-year vision for patient experience and drive it forward through close, hands-on partnership with Engineering.

What You'll Do (Job Duties/Responsibilities)

Strategy & Vision

  • Define the multi-year vision and roadmap for the patient experience across Wheel's white-labeled consumer surfaces, balancing partner-specific requirements with a coherent, scalable core product

  • Establish a point of view on where the patient experience should be standardized across partners versus configured per partner, and build the frameworks to support that decision-making

  • Translate enterprise partner requirements across market segments into a unified product strategy that serves patients well regardless of the front door they came through

  • Champion design as a strategic differentiator; work hand-in-hand with Design to set a bar for what a trustworthy, AI+human powered patient experience looks like at scale

Systems Thinking & Cross-Functional Execution

  • Map the patient journey end to end, from first touchpoint through clinical encounter to follow-up, and identify where friction, drop-off, or trust gaps occur

  • Partner closely with Engineering, Clinical Operations, and partner-facing teams to design solutions that hold up across a distributed network of clinicians and multiple partner integrations

  • Define the product requirements, success metrics, and evaluation criteria for AI-driven capabilities within the patient experience (for example, intake, triage support, or personalization), including partnering on model and product tradeoffs and on iteration post-launch based on real usage data

  • Break down ambiguous, cross-functional problems into clear requirements and plans, and drive alignment with Engineering from concept through launch and iteration

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as a primary product voice in conversations with Account Management and their enterprise partners about patient experience, translating patient experience strategy into terms that resonate with partner stakeholders

  • Communicate vision, tradeoffs, and progress clearly to executive leadership, engineering teams, and non-technical partner stakeholders alike

  • Mentor and influence other product managers on systems thinking and product craft in partnership with their managers

Who You Are (Job Qualifications)

  • 8+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning consumer-facing products at a senior or lead level (Staff, Principal or equivalent scope). Leveling will be based on demonstrated scope of impact in the interview process

  • Direct experience building consumer products, ideally including B2B2C or white-label models where the end user and the paying customer are different

  • Demonstrated systems thinking: experience designing products that span multiple stakeholders, technical layers, or partner integrations

  • Real, hands-on experience delivering AI-powered products and features, not just using AI tools in your work. You can speak to the tradeoffs, evaluation methods, and iteration cycles involved in bringing an AI capability to production

  • Experience navigating the tension between enterprise partner requirements and end-user needs in a B2B2C model, particularly within healthcare or other highly regulated industries, and building product decision frameworks that satisfy compliance, brand, and clinical constraints while still serving the end consumer well

  • Outstanding written and verbal communicator who can move fluidly between consumer experience detail and executive-level strategy

  • A track record as a builder: comfortable in ambiguity, willing to get hands-on with design, data, or requirements detail when needed to keep Engineering moving fast

Skills & Competencies

  • Mix of vision and execution: able to set a compelling multi-year direction and also drive the week-to-week product decisions that translate into shipped work

  • Strong product sense for consumer experience, balanced with the operational and technical judgment needed for a B2B2C model

  • Experience partnering with enterprise or channel partners on product decisions

  • Technical fluency across APIs, integration patterns (webhooks, headless architectures, MCP and other emerging protocols), and platform product design

  • Comfortable synthesizing input from clinical, engineering, data, and partner stakeholders into a clear product direction

  • Data-driven, with the judgment to know when qualitative signal matters more than a metric

  • High ownership and autonomy; thrives in a fast-moving, lean environment

Salary and Perks

Pay Range: $201,700-$301,700 plus equity

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, the final level determined (Staff or Principal), scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations.

Wheel is unable to consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.

As an employee of Wheel, you’ll enjoy our Total Rewards Program to help secure your financial future and preserve your health and well-being, including:

  • Medical, Dental and Vision

  • Ancillary: Life, Short and Long Term Disability

  • 401K match

  • Flexible PTO

  • Parental Leave

  • Stock options

  • Additional programs and perks

Wheel is committed to equal employment opportunities for all team members. Every decision we make regarding employment is solely based on merit, competence, and performance. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

Research shows that underrepresented groups typically apply only if they meet 100% of the criteria listed. At Wheel, we encourage women, people of color, and LGBTQ+ job seekers to apply for positions even if they don’t check every box for the role.

title: Lead Solutions Engineer - Central / East
description_html:
Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

We’re looking for a Lead Solutions Engineer to inspire our customers by helping them understand the art of what’s possible with the Webflow platform. You will tell our differentiated story that shows how our solution helps them meet their business objectives.

The Solutions Engineering team plays a vital role by partnering closely with our customers as well as with Sales, Customer Success, and Product to ensure mutual, long-term success. We aim to deeply understand our customers’ strategic objectives and technical requirements. We architect and demonstrate innovative solutions that unlock meaningful business value for our customers. Additionally, we champion the voice of our customers by understanding market trends and influencing product direction.

About the role:

  • Location: Remote-first (United States; ON, Canada)
    • Must reside in Central or Eastern Time Zones
    • This role will require an in-person onboarding session in San Francisco, CA
  • Full-time
  • Permanent
  • Exempt
  • Our cash compensation amount for this role ranges depending on the cost of labor of the geographic area. The ranges shared below may change if you are hired in another geographic location.
    • United States (all figures cited below in USD and pertain to workers in the United States)
      • Zone A: $208,500 - $245,000
      • Zone B: $194,000 - $228,000
      • Zone C: $182,000 - $214,000
    • Canada (All figures cited below in CAD and pertain to workers in ON, Canada)
      • 200,000 - 235,000

For sales roles, the ranges provided are the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) ranges, meaning that the ranges include both the sales commissions target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Webflow and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s market location, job related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends

Please visit our Careers page for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

  • Application Information:
    • Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled
    • This posting is for an existing vacancy
  • Reporting to the Manager, Solutions Engineering

As a Lead Solutions Engineer, you’ll …

  • Partner with 2-3 Account Executives & support multiple active customer opportunities across our growing Enterprise segment, proactively communicating with stakeholders to ensure on-time solution delivery
  • Guide customers through the evaluation process of Webflow ensuring that our solution meets key business objectives and technical requirements
  • Conduct deep discovery, solution design, technical validation and business case development
  • Present effective stories through demonstrations that highlight the benefits of using Webflow to solve key customer objectives and challenges
  • Lead hands-on workshops and trials where appropriate
  • Influence product direction for short & long-term success in Enterprise by representing the customer voice
  • Lead strategic cross-functional initiatives that are key to advancing Webflow’s mission of bringing development superpowers to everyone
  • Travel up to 25%

About you:

Requirements:

  • 6+ years of experience as a Solutions Engineer, ideally in the web development space
  • Exhibit an advanced understanding of APIs and web programming languages — HTML, CSS & JavaScript
  • Take a consultative approach and are passionate about helping customers solve problems
  • Consistently demonstrate strong storytelling within the context of discovery and/or product demo sessions

You’ll thrive as a Lead Solutions Engineer if you:

  • Possess strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Creatively problem solve and automate routine tasks with AI
  • Enjoy working autonomously, creatively, and kindly with your teammates while empowering and supporting those around you
  • Demonstrate excellent coaching, writing, discovery and presentation skills
  • Lead with enthusiasm for earning customer trust and deepening customer relationships
  • Are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and adaptable to changing priorities
  • Stay curious and open to growth — demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.

Our Core Behaviors:

  • Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.
  • Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.
  • Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.
  • Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

Benefits

  • Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.
  • Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.
  • Support for every stage of family life. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.
  • Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.
  • Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.
  • Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally.
  • Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.
  • Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.

Remote, together

At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Stay connected

Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our Webflow Blog, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and/or Glassdoor.

Please note:

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for confidential accommodation requests will be administered.

To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment.

If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes.

For information about how Webflow processes your personal information, please review Webflow’s Applicant Privacy Notice.

title: Events Manager
description_html:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

BASE SALARY: $80,000 to $115,000 per year, paid semi-monthly

The Role

Launch Potato’s sales and partnerships team spends a lot of time on the road. Over the next twelve months, we expect to attend roughly 26 external conferences and trade shows, with the busiest stretch falling between August and October.

We’re looking for someone to take ownership of that program and make sure every event is thoughtfully planned, well organized, and set up to drive real business outcomes.

You’ll own the external event calendar end to end for our revenue teams: helping determine which shows we attend, coordinating who goes, managing logistics and travel, preparing materials, supporting meeting planning, and making sure follow-up happens after the event.

This role is less about large-scale brand activations and more about making our conference strategy run exceptionally well. Success looks like sellers arriving prepared, calendars full of the right meetings, materials ready, logistics handled, and clear next steps coming out of every show.

You’ll work closely with senior leaders across the business, including the CRO, and have the opportunity to turn what is currently a highly manual process into a more scalable and repeatable event program.

It’s a great fit for someone who enjoys being organized, moving quickly, working cross-functionally, and owning the details that make a high-performing commercial team more effective.

Why This Seat

  • You work directly with the CRO. Not through three layers. You will sit in the revenue conversation and see how deals actually get made.
  • Real ownership from day one. The program exists but the system does not. You get to build it.
  • Visible impact. Your work shows up as booked meetings and closed partnerships, not as a slide in someone else's deck.
  • You will not be doing this alone. Judy runs our on-site logistics at HQ and is genuinely great at it. She is your partner on assets, swag, and shipping, not a resource you task out.
  • Room to grow into more. As the business grows and we take on bigger activations, this seat grows with it.

What You'll Own

The show calendar

  • Own the annual trade show and conference calendar, including which shows we attend and why
  • Bring recommendations to the CRO rather than waiting to be asked which shows matter
  • Work backward from each show: passes, deadlines, sponsorships, booth space, speaking slots
  • Build the 2027 calendar before the deadlines build it for us

Making the team ready

  • Chase the team for who is attending, by when, and make the call visible early
  • Keep the CRO ahead of every deadline, so he reacts instead of remembering
  • Coordinate with the design team on collateral, one-pagers, and sales assets, and project manage them to the date
  • Partner with Judy on swag, samples, and shipping so the right materials arrive in the right city

On site, for the shows that need it

  • Attend roughly five shows a year where we exhibit, host a dinner, or run executive meetings
  • Run the logistics on those so the sellers sell and nobody is cutting name tags an hour before the door opens
  • Be the go-to for the team when something breaks on the ground, whether or not you are there

The money and the mechanics

  • Track and manage the event budget, and flag overruns before they happen
  • Own month-end reconciliation with Finance and answer the questions before they get asked
  • Help us move onto a modern travel and expense platform, then run the program on it
  • Build the small activations that deepen partner relationships: a dinner, a golf outing, the thing a partner actually wants

What You'll Bring

  • 3+ years running events, trade shows, or field programs in support of a sales, partnerships, or business development team
  • Direct experience owning a conference or trade show end to end, including vendor negotiation, booth or sponsorship contracts, and a budget you were accountable for
  • A track record of chasing people down and getting an answer, warmly and without needing permission
  • Comfort working remotely with a team that is spread out and moving fast
  • Strong written communication, because most of this job is written and most of it is asynchronous
  • Real curiosity about AI tools and how to use them to do more than the job technically requires

Nice to Have

  • Experience in performance marketing, affiliate, adtech, fintech, or digital media
  • You have run a program on a travel, expense, or event platform such as Ramp, Brex, Navan, TripActions, Cvent, or Concur, and have an opinion about what works
  • Experience helping select or roll out one of those platforms
  • Existing relationships with conference organizers in our space

What Great Looks Like

In 90 days: you know the calendar cold, the next three shows are fully handled, and our Co-founder & CRO have stopped tracking event deadlines.

In six months: the 2027 calendar is built and budgeted. Sellers come to you with which shows they want, and you bring the recommendation up. Finance stops chasing event expenses because reconciliation is clean.

In a year: the program runs on a system rather than in someone's head. You are proposing the small activations that win partners, not just executing the ones you were handed.

This Isn't the Right Seat If You

  • Want to design large brand activations and experiential campaigns. We do small and targeted, deliberately.
  • Need someone to tell you what to do next. Most of this job is noticing what is about to fall over.
  • Are looking for a step toward people management in the next year or two. This is an individual contributor seat.
  • Prefer to work through a defined process someone else built. You are building the process.

Total Compensation

Base salary is set according to market rates for the nearest major metro and varies based on Launch Potato’s Levels Framework. Your compensation package includes a base salary, profit-sharing bonus, and competitive benefits. Launch Potato is a performance-driven company, which means once you are hired, future increases will be based on company and personal performance, not annual cost of living adjustments.

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

Since day one, we've been committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Lead Affiliate Manager
description_html:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

This role is US remote. You will need to sit in a state where we are registered to do business, which the recruiter will confirm with you early.

Why This Seat

Our publisher book is growing faster than the team can reach it, and this seat exists to close that gap. You will carry a margin number from the start, own your accounts end to end, and ramp in weeks rather than quarters.

Room to build, not inherit. Publishers are arriving faster than we can onboard them, so the accounts you grow are ones you shaped rather than ones handed to you finished.

Multiple verticals, not one. Insurance, personal finance, and our wider partner network. Most affiliate manager seats narrow over time until you are the person who does one thing. This one is built to broaden. You start where you are strongest and pick up the rest as you go.

Our own offers behind you. You are not selling inventory a publisher has already seen from four other networks. That changes how the conversation goes.

What You'll Bring

  • Four or more years managing publishers in affiliate. Direct publisher or partner management for an advertiser or a network.
  • A margin or revenue number you personally owned. You can name it, name where it started, and name what you changed.
  • A regulated vertical. Insurance, credit, lending, health, or personal finance, and the judgment that comes with working inside real constraints.
  • You treat a no as incomplete information. When an opportunity stalls on compliance, you find out precisely what blocked it, then work both sides reshaping the partner's assets, or making the case internally where the rule allows room. You don't abandon good opportunities and you don't wait for someone else to solve them.
  • Tracking platform fluency. You are comfortable in a performance platform and you can tell when the data is lying. We use Tune, with IntegriShield and Lashback on the compliance side. If you learned somewhere else, that is fine.
  • Proactive optimization. You read the reporting, you see where a partner could scale or optimize, and you act. Spotting it is not the skill. Doing something about it is.

Nice to Have

  • Depth of relationship in insurance specifically
  • More than one regulated vertical
  • Experience across both direct publisher relationships and network distribution

What You'll Own

  • Your publishers, end to end. The relationship, the opportunities, the scaling, the results.
  • The margin on your book. You will have a number. You will know where you are against it.
  • A book that stays diversified. If one partner going quiet takes half your margin with it, the book is built wrong. Managing that risk is part of the job, not something you do once it becomes urgent.
  • Compliance, before it becomes a problem. You monitor partner traffic actively and catch the issue while it is still small, then raise it with the partner directly.
  • The relationship itself. Not just answering when a partner writes. Keeping them warm, keeping them moving, keeping them glad they work with us.
  • What you learn, shared. We have a weekly session on what is working, and people flag things in between without being asked. That exchange is how this team gets better, and it only works if everyone puts in.

What Great Looks Like

  • In 90 days, you know our offers, our platform, and your partners. You have had your first real optimization conversation with a publisher and it moved a number.
  • In 6 months, you are running your book independently and pacing against your margin target, and you have started picking up the verticals you did not arrive with.
  • In 12 months, you have driven $500,000 in incremental margin, your book survives a partner going quiet, and someone else on the team is running a play you figured out.

This Isn't the Right Seat If You

  • Want a book that is already built and a slow quarter to learn it
  • Treat compliance as a wall rather than a problem to solve internally and externally
  • Prefer to specialize narrowly and stay there
  • Margin at or below $200,000 in a single year. No direct affiliate publisher management.

Total Compensation

Base: $110,000 to $130,000, set by location and the depth of your affiliate experience

Bonus: performance incentive also based on your expertise and level that you come in

Base salary is set according to market rates for the nearest major metro and varies based on Launch Potato’s Levels Framework. Your compensation package includes a base salary, profit-sharing bonus, and competitive benefits. Launch Potato is a performance-driven company, which means once you are hired, future increases will be based on company and personal performance, not annual cost of living adjustments.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Build Loop
description_html:
Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help us build the next generation of Agentic Codebases

About the role:

  • Location: Remote-first (Argentina)
  • Permanent, full-time employee (this is not a contractor position)
  • Application Information:
  • Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled
  • This posting is for an existing vacancy
  • Reporting to the Senior Engineering Manager, Developer Productivity

As a Senior Software Engineer, Developer Productivity, you'll:

  • Design and build the Nest.js service scaffolding that lets product teams stand up new backend services in our next-generation monorepo
  • Implement paved paths, generators, and the platform primitives that make a new service work on day one rather than after a week of wiring.
  • Build the seams that let new services run independently of our existing monolith.
  • Own the deployment story for services and web applications on Cloudflare, and the interoperability with our existing AWS and Kubernetes estate managed through Pulumi and Argo CD.
  • Lead migrations of substantial codebases into the monorepo and turn each one into a repeatable recipe rather than a bespoke effort.
  • Partner directly with product teams as platform customers, treating their adoption as the measure of success and their friction as your backlog.
  • Raise the leverage of the whole team by encoding what you learn into tooling, generators and agent-assisted workflows, so the next migration costs less than the last.
  • Participate in engineering citizenship activities such as co-authoring engineering blogs, strengthening our hiring processes, and leading internal hackathon teams.

About you

Requirements:

  • BA/BS Degree or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years building and operating backend services in production
  • Demonstrated experience in backend service design defining service boundaries, contracts and data ownership, not only implementing within them
  • Business-level fluency to read, write and speak in English

You'll thrive as a Senior Software Engineer, Developer Productivity, if you:

  • Have worked inside a large, heavily-coupled codebase and found the seams: extracting or bypassing functionality incrementally, behind behaviour-preserving contracts
  • Are fluent in TypeScript and Node, and comfortable with edge runtimes.
  • Have hands-on experience with monorepo tooling at scale (Nx, Turborepo or similar) and understand why build-graph correctness is a product concern rather than a config detail.
  • Treat migration work as engineering rather than chores: you budget for the parts that fail silently, verify generated output rather than trusting a green build, and know that bug-for-bug translation beats improvement when the goal is proving nothing changed.
  • Enjoy being a platform engineer with real customers — partnering with product teams, adapting the platform to how they actually work rather than requiring them to change, and measuring yourself on their adoption.
  • Are comfortable working across cloud boundaries, with a considered view on where a workload belongs and what crossing between clouds costs in latency and spend.
  • Communicate decisions in writing well enough that someone can pick up your work from the ticket — and are willing to say plainly when the fast answer and the right answer diverge.
  • Stay curious and open to growth — demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.

Our Core Behaviors:

  • Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.
  • Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.
  • Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.
  • Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

Benefits

  • Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.
  • Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.
  • Support for every stage of family life. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.
  • Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.
  • Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.
  • Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally.
  • Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.
  • Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.

Remote, together

At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Stay connected

Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our Webflow Blog, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and/or Glassdoor.

Please note:

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for confidential accommodation requests will be administered.

To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment.

If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes.

For information about how Webflow processes your personal information, please review Webflow’s Applicant Privacy Notice.

title: Engineering Manager
description_html:
At NetBox Labs, our mission is to make it easier to build and manage complex networks. As a product company, we do that by developing innovative software for network professionals delivered on-premises and in the cloud.

We believe in the power of community and collaboration, and we are looking for a hands-on, player-coach Engineering Manager to lead one of our talented teams. These teams build our core software applications including NetBox and NetBox Add-ons, SDKs, and Plugins, and our observability suite including Diode, Diode Agents and SDKs, and Orb. Much of this development is open source and done in collaboration with our community, but also spans source-available and proprietary software. This role reports to the Director of Engineering.

In this role you will:

  • Lead a squad of engineers day-to-day while staying hands-on: reviewing code, jumping into design discussions, and occasionally shipping code yourself to unblock the team or model best practices.

  • Drive execution relentlessly — break down ambiguous problems into clear plans, set sprint goals, remove blockers fast, and hold the team accountable to deadlines.

  • Own the software development lifecycle for your team's projects, from planning and design through implementation, testing, and release.

  • Run effective sprint planning, stand-ups, and retros using GitHub and internal tools, helping engineers break work into well-scoped, executable pieces.

  • Champion modern, secure software development practices and keep quality bars high without slowing the team down.

  • Partner closely with product managers to translate customer and community problems into shippable plans, pushing back with data when scope or timelines don't add up.

  • Coach and mentor engineers individually — give direct, timely feedback, help them grow technically, and build a strong bench for future hiring.

  • Foster a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing within the team.

  • Act as a liaison between your team and the broader tech community, supporting open-source contributors and guiding community-facing initiatives where relevant.

  • Report progress transparently to engineering leadership, flagging risks early rather than after they've become problems.

  • Stay close enough to the code and the architecture to make credible calls on technical trade-offs, while trusting your engineers to own the details of implementation.

You will work closely with:

  • Director of Engineering to coordinate cross-functional initiatives and ensure your team's work runs smoothly in our commercial products.

  • Product team to understand customer and community problems and turn them into a stellar user experience.

  • Peer engineering managers to plan cross-functional projects, clarify ownership, surface dependencies, and clear blockers together.

Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager or Team Lead, ideally in a player-coach capacity where you're still writing code or reviewing PRs regularly.

  • A track record of driving projects to completion on tight timelines, with a strong bias toward action and unblocking your team over process for its own sake.

  • Strong technical background sufficient to review designs and code, and earn credibility with senior engineers.

  • Experience with Agile methodologies, DevOps, and CI/CD in a fast-moving environment.

  • Proficiency with GitHub for code management, project tracking, and collaboration.

  • Solid understanding of software security principles and practices.

  • Experience with open-source software development and community engagement is a plus.

  • Excellent, direct communication skills — comfortable giving and receiving fast feedback in a remote, async-first environment.

  • Proven ability to coach engineers and help them grow, while still being the person who rolls up their sleeves when the team needs it.

It would be fantastic if you have the following background:

  • Networking industry experience.

  • Familiarity with Python, Django, Go, gRPC, or OpenTelemetry.

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms and services (e.g., AWS, Azure).

  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Understanding of data privacy regulations and compliance requirements.

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.
