description_html:
TL;DR: We’re looking for a GTM Engineer to automate low-value commercial work and build the systems that generate qualified pipeline at scale. You’ll own the GTM infrastructure end to end: design the data model, keep the CRM reliable, connect the stack, deploy AI agents, automate outbound and inbound workflows, and continuously improve how we acquire and retain customers.

About White Circle

White Circle is an AI Safety company building the safety, reliability, and optimization layer for AI systems. At the core of our platform are policies – simple natural-language rules that define what an AI model should and shouldn’t do. We automatically test, enforce, and continuously improve these policies at scale.

  • We’ve raised $11M from top funds, founders, and senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, DeepMind, Datadog, Sentry, and others

  • We process over 100M+ API calls every month

  • We fine-tune and train our own LLMs so they run faster and cheaper than any open or proprietary model

We’re at a multi-million dollar run rate already having signed customers like Lovable and multiple neobanks. You’ll be joining at the most exciting time - early enough that the equity can be life changing but at a point where demand has been proven.

We’re a small, highly focused team. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and build the category-defining company in AI safety - this role is for you!


What You’ll Do

Automate low-value work out of the commercial process so the Sales team can spend more time closing deals

  • Design and build the systems that power how we find, acquire, and retain customers (both outbound and inbound)

  • Own the CRM: you make sure our data is clean, structured, and reliable

  • Build internal tools, API integrations, and custom automation logic

  • Have real ownership & shape the playbook: what we build, use, how it fits together, and how it scales

  • Design and deploy AI agents across the GTM motion (e.g., account research, pre-call intelligence, personalised outreach, etc)

  • Wire it directly into our operational systems so it changes how the team works

  • Design the GTM data model (accounts, contacts and opportunities)

  • Build and manage data pipeline, enrichment and integrations across the stack

  • Build, ship and iterate fast

What We’re Looking For

Background & Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in GTM engineering, technical RevOps, or a growth role where you were building automations and pipelines

  • Experience designing and scaling systems in a high-growth company

  • Hands-on with modern GTM tooling - Claude Code, Clay, Apollo, Instantly, n8n or similar - you've built multi-step enrichment and sequencing workflows, not just set up a table

  • Comfortable with Python or SQL well enough to work with data, call APIs, and build lightweight scoring or enrichment logic

  • Top-of-funnel focused - you know how to build systems that generate qualified pipeline at scale, from ICP definition through to booked meetings

  • Experience in programmatic SEO and AEO

  • Analytical and experimental mindset: proven ability to design tests, measure impact, and iterate quickly.

  • Proven AI deployment experience (e.g., automations, agents, workflows)

What success looks like in the first 6 months

In your first six months, we would expect you to identify the highest-converting early segments, build a functioning outbound and follow-up engine, create clear messaging for one or two strong wedges, generate a meaningful pipeline of qualified conversations, and help convert early pilots or customers. Just as importantly, we would expect the company to understand its GTM motion far better because of your work.

Compensation & benefits

  • Competitive compensation package, including equity

  • Flexible time off

  • Health insurance

  • Mental health support, including coverage for therapy when you need it

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Learning and development support for courses, conferences, and opportunities to grow your skills

  • All the hardware, subscriptions, tools, and services you need

  • Team off-sites twice a year: we’ve recently been to the Alps, Saint-Tropez, and Marbella

How we hire

  1. Intro call (30 min)

  2. Take-home exercise

  3. Interview with Head of Revenue & Data Engineer (60 min)

  4. Final call with our CEO & Head of Engineering (45 min)

🌍 CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally.

🚀 In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast-paced, high-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries—continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead.

🌱 We believe our future is built by bold, ambitious individuals who are driven to make a real difference. Our “make it happen” culture empowers you to take ownership of your career and accelerate your personal and professional development from day one.

🌐 With over 700 CUBERs across 19 countries spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, we operate as one team with a shared mission to transform regulatory compliance. Diversity, collaboration, and purpose are the heartbeat of our success.

💡 We were among the first to harness the power of AI in regulatory intelligence, and we continue to lead with our cutting-edge technology. At CUBE, You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI research and engineering in developing impactful solutions that are reshaping the world of regulatory compliance.

CUBE is a well-established brand with a dominant presence across the world's largest financial institutions, trusted by GSIBs and leading Tier 1 banks globally. CUBE Intel is our mid-market product - purpose-built for mid-market firms that need robust regulatory change management without the complexity of an enterprise deployment. This presents a real opportunity for the right person to build a territory, bring on new logos, and make their mark. We move fast, we listen to ideas, and we back the people who bring them.

Responsibilities:

  • The new Account Executive will drive CUBE's sales efforts, and will be responsible for winning new mid-market logos across regulated businesses.

  • Lead the full sales cycle end‑to‑end, from initial engagement and qualification through to commercial negotiation and close, consistently achieving net‑new customer acquisition targets.

  • Drive new business generation through prospecting, market mapping, and targeted outreach.

  • Engage and influence senior stakeholders (including Heads of Legal & Compliance, Compliance Directors and equivalent leaders) to build a broad vision of strategic long-term partnership and value.

  • Maintain rigorous CRM and forecasting discipline, providing an accurate, evidence-based view of pipeline, deal progression and expected close dates.

  • Provide timely and accurate forecasts to the Head of Sales, on a weekly basis

  • Effective use of AI tools to drive GTM efficiency, prospecting, and territory planning.

  • Track and drive improvement in qualified-to-close conversion rates across the funnel, not just pipeline volume.

  • Contribute actively to the evolution of CUBE Intel's GTM strategy, using market and customer insights to refine targeting, messaging and sales execution.

Skills & Experience

  • You will be a hands-on sales professional with a strong new business sales background and a proven track record of selling SaaS solutions

  • Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

  • Ability to build trusted, long-term relationships with new prospects and senior stakeholders.

  • Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles in a B2B environment.

  • A self-starter who is proactive in building their own pipeline; whilst a dedicated BDR function will support lead generation, candidates must be comfortable with independent outreach and market mapping.

Desirable

  • Experience with structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC or equivalent.

  • Background in financial services, compliance, risk or regulatory technology - direct sector experience is a strong advantage but not a necessity.

Interested?

If you are passionate about leveraging technology to transform regulatory compliance and meet the qualifications outlined above, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and interest in CUBE.​

CUBE is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Onboarding consultant

description_html:
Our Purpose

Scheduling isn’t simply filling shifts. It’s finding the sweet spot that enables businesses to grow and team members to enjoy the perfect work/life balance.

At Planday from Xero, we aim to use Agentic AI to build a future where managers seamlessly can free up invaluable time for their business and teams. We’re not just building software; we’re on a mission to make shift work more human, to change work/life balance from a luxury to a reality for all shift workers. We’re using advanced technology to help humans reach their full potential. At work and in life.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and helps create perfect schedules for hundreds of thousands of users across the world. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How you’ll make an impact

As a Senior Onboarding Consultant, you will drive the success of Planday by leading new customers through a comprehensive onboarding and implementation journey tailored to their business size, operational complexity, and technical requirements.

You will own more complex and strategic onboarding engagements, bringing a high degree of autonomy, strong implementation discipline, and a consultative mindset to every customer interaction. You will combine deep product expertise with strong technical aptitude to help customers design scalable ways of working, manage change effectively, and realise value quickly.

You will play a key role in helping customers successfully implement Planday within their business, especially where workflows, stakeholder groups, system configuration, and integration requirements are more advanced. Your ability to lead technically credible conversations, guide customers through implementation decisions, and proactively manage risks will be critical to achieving strong adoption, smooth go-lives, and long-term customer success.

What you’ll do

  • Project manage end-to-end onboarding and multi-site implementation for upper mid-market and enterprise customer portfolios, with full ownership of strategic, technically complex, and high-value customer engagements.

  • Act as the primary implementation lead for customers with more advanced operational or technical requirements, including complex workflows, multi-site setups, and tailored rollout plans

  • Run high-quality discovery to understand customer goals, business processes, operational challenges, and implementation risks, and translate these into a clear onboarding plan

  • Guide customers through solution design and configuration decisions, ensuring Planday is implemented in a way that aligns with their business needs and supports long-term success

  • Lead implementation conversations with a broad range of stakeholders, including operational, commercial, technical, and executive contacts

  • Deliver a high-quality onboarding experience through a consultative, structured, and customer-centric approach

  • Proactively identify delivery risks, technical blockers, and adoption challenges, and drive them through to resolution

  • Support customers through change management and go-live planning to ensure successful launches and strong early adoption

  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Product, and other internal teams to deliver a seamless customer experience and smooth handover across the customer lifecycle

  • Maintain strong implementation governance, accurate CRM records, and disciplined use of internal processes, systems, and onboarding best practices

  • Use data, customer insight, and frontline experience to identify opportunities to improve onboarding playbooks, implementation processes, and customer outcomes

  • Act as a senior member of the team by sharing knowledge, raising the bar on execution, and contributing to continuous improvement across onboarding.

What you’ll bring with you

  • Proven experience in onboarding, implementation, customer success, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role, with experience owning more complex customer engagements

  • Strong SaaS implementation experience, with the ability to lead customers through structured rollout and change processes from kickoff to go-live

  • Strong technical aptitude and confidence discussing system configuration, implementation requirements, workflow design, and integration-related considerations with customers

  • Experience managing multiple stakeholders across operational, technical, and leadership audiences

  • Ability to run excellent discovery, uncover customer needs, and translate them into practical implementation plans and business outcomes

  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to simplify complex topics and build credibility with a wide range of stakeholders

  • Excellent project, time management, and prioritisation skills across multiple concurrent customer journeys

  • A proactive, self-directed approach with strong ownership, sound judgment, and comfort operating with autonomy and accountability

  • Empathy, patience, and a solutions-focused mindset, paired with the confidence to challenge constructively when needed

  • Confidence using CRM systems and customer engagement tools, with strong process discipline and attention to detail

  • High professionalism, integrity, and a collaborative, low-ego approach

  • Experience in workforce-intensive industries such as hospitality, retail, healthcare, or shift-based environments is preferred

  • Experience working on technically involved implementations, including integrations, data considerations, or more complex business process design, is highly desirable

Success looks like

  • Customers successfully go live on time with strong adoption and clear alignment to their business goals

  • Complex onboarding and implementation projects are managed effectively, with risks identified early and handled proactively

  • Customers feel confident in their solution design, implementation approach, and path to value

  • Strong stakeholder relationships are built across customer teams, including more senior and technical contacts

  • High customer satisfaction, strong implementation quality, and minimal escalations

  • Consistent achievement of onboarding goals and KPIs, with strong ownership of outcomes

  • Positive contribution to team culture, capability uplift, and continuous improvement across the onboarding function

This position description is intended merely as a guideline of the responsibilities involved in the position. The employee is expected to perform any other duties as reasonably required by their Manager.

At Planday, we offer you

  • Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

  • On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

  • Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

  • Flexible remote work

  • Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

  • Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

  • Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture, and we highly value the strength that diverse backgrounds offer.

As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all our candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process.

All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to any personal characteristics.

title: Solution Architect
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Certa
description_html:
Certa is the AI-first third-party operating system. Enterprises, from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups, use our no-code platform to onboard, assess, and monitor their vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. We have processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries, and are backed by Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures.

The Solution Architect is the primary functional lead on Certa implementations, sitting at the intersection of business consulting and technical delivery. You'll translate complex client requirements into scalable platform solutions, own the solution design from discovery through go-live, and serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders ranging from procurement leads and risk officers to CIOs and CPOs. It's a high-impact, client-facing role for an experienced consultant who combines deep domain expertise in TPRM, vendor management, or procurement with hands-on implementation skills and a passion for solving complex operational challenges through technology.

What You'll Do

  • Lead solution design & delivery: Lead end-to-end solution design for Certa implementations, translating client TPRM frameworks, risk processes, and business requirements into scalable, best-practice configurations, and own the solution blueprint and technical design documentation for each engagement.

  • Configure & integrate: Design and build workflow automation, intake forms, approval routing, risk scoring models, reporting, and integration patterns (APIs, SSO/SAML, ERPs, GRC tools, procurement systems), driving to a high-quality, on-time go-live.

  • Advise clients: Lead discovery workshops and requirements-gathering sessions across procurement, compliance, legal, IT, and risk, acting as a trusted advisor on TPRM, supplier onboarding, and procurement automation best practices, and facilitating process-mapping and gap-analysis exercises.

  • Manage the engagement: Manage client expectations proactively around scope, feasibility, and trade-offs, and produce high-quality solution documentation, configuration guides, and knowledge-transfer materials that enable long-term client self-sufficiency.

  • Mentor & build the practice: Support and mentor junior Implementation Consultants through technical guidance and design reviews, and contribute reusable accelerators, templates, and playbooks while staying current on platform releases and emerging TPRM, ESG, and procurement trends.

What You'll Need

  • Domain experience: 5+ years in TPRM, vendor/supplier management, procurement, GRC, or supply chain operations, with a solid understanding of the enterprise vendor lifecycle (onboarding, due diligence, risk assessment, contract management, off-boarding) and familiarity with frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, or DORA.

  • Implementation consulting: 3+ years of hands-on implementation consulting delivering enterprise SaaS or workflow automation (ideally TPRM, procurement, or related domains), with a proven track record leading full-cycle implementations from discovery through go-live at complex enterprise clients, across Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid methodologies.

  • Technical skills: Proficiency configuring no-code/low-code workflow or BPM platforms (Certa, Appian, Pega, Salesforce, or ServiceNow), working knowledge of integration patterns (REST APIs, webhooks, SSO/SAML, data import/export), and the ability to read JSON/XML (basic scripting or query experience a plus).

  • Landscape & tooling: Awareness of the TPRM/procurement technology landscape (Coupa, Ariba, ServiceNow, Archer, OneTrust, or comparable), and proficiency with project and documentation tooling (JIRA, Confluence, Visio, Lucidchart, or equivalents).

  • Communication & mindset: An exceptional communicator who translates technical concepts for business stakeholders and business context for technical teams, a structured analytical thinker comfortable with ambiguity, highly organized and self-directed in a fast-paced, remote-first environment, with a client-centric commitment to delivering value and building long-term trusted relationships.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Compensation: Top of market salary + bonuses and equity

  • Time off: 49 days paid time off

  • Benefits: PTO, full benefits, retirement and wellness plans

  • Growth: Professional development support, remote workspace setup bonus

  • Team building: Annual company offsites in exciting locations around the world

Location

Certa is a remote-first company and we hire globally. We believe strongly in each team member working from the location that they choose. Should Certers wish to meet and work in person, they have 3 lively office locations they can travel to:

  • London

  • San Francisco

  • Jaipur

The perfect place for Certers to collaborate, co-work, and have face-to-face meetings.

Why Certa

  • Category leadership. Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools - recognition that we're defining the category, not following it.

  • Industry recognition. We've been honored across the analyst and awards landscape, including Top Tech and Customer Value distinctions in The Hackett Group's 2026 Risk Management SolutionMap, the ProcureTech100 (Advanced AI and Risk Management categories), and Best Overall eProcurement Software in the FinTech Breakthrough Awards.

  • A top place to work. Certa was named one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers in the US. We're a fast-growing company where you'll wear many hats, ship quickly, and shape decisions that matter.

  • Real scale with strong backing. We've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries. We're well-funded by leading investors including Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures, on the back of an oversubscribed Series B, headed towards Series C.

We're excited to meet you!

AI at BetterUp

title: Founding Product Designer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Adclear
description_html:
Founding Product Designer

At Adclear, we're building the trust layer for how the world's most regulated companies bring products to market. Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review that slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We're turning the function that has always said 'no' into infrastructure that says 'yes, and here's how'.

This is a fundamental shift in how regulated industries and compliance teams operate, and we're only at the beginning. The product you'll design is what people actually touch when they experience that shift.

Founded in 2024, we've already earned the trust of leading innovators as well as established enterprises including Monzo, Lloyds, PensionBee, Kraken, Coinbase and many others. Our early traction let us raise 2.6m in funding, and we're now scaling fast. We're building the product engine that turns a genuinely novel category into something people love to use, and this is where you come in.

The Basics

Location: London (4 days a week in our Farringdon office)

Reports to: founders, working day to day alongside our CTO

The role: our first dedicated designer, owning the product experience end to end

The Role

You'd be the first designer at Adclear. Today, design here is developer-led and largely AI/vibe-coded, with no single owner. That's the gap you're filling: the product's look, feel and flow are yours to mold, and the design function is yours to build from the ground up.

This role has two distinct halves, and we're looking for someone who can genuinely do both.

The first is improving what already exists. Adclear is a live product used regularly by enterprises and other customers. You'll bring coherence to the UI, refine and properly apply our existing design system across the app, improve existing functionality, and design complex new features on top of it. Strong UX judgment matters as much as UI polish here: a lot of this is making genuinely complex, regulated workflows navigable for non-technical users like compliance reviewers and marketers.

The second is zero-to-one. We'll likely be building two new product lines from scratch alongside the core product, which means heavy discovery, lots of proof-of-concepts, and rapid iteration through quick mockups, AI-assisted prototypes and user testing. You'll be speaking with customers regularly across both workstreams, not just the new ones.

You won't be handed tidy specs and asked to make them pretty. You'll sit in the messy middle: talking to compliance teams and marketers at banks and fintechs, working out what they actually need, and turning genuinely hard, ambiguous problems into a product that feels obvious once it exists.

This is a design role with a real product management edge. You'll work in tandem with our CTO to shape what we build and why, not just how it looks. You'll help set priorities, scope releases and make the calls that move the roadmap.

What you'll do

  • Own the end-to-end product experience: from problem definition and research through to interaction design, high-fidelity UI and shipped product

  • Bring consistency to the existing product: refine and coherently apply our design system across the app, and raise the UX and UI bar on what's already live

  • Work directly with our CTO to shape the roadmap, scope releases and decide what's worth building, wearing a product manager hat alongside your design one

  • Lead discovery and build proof-of-concepts for new product lines, moving from sketch to something real fast rather than over weeks

  • Run your own research: get on customer calls across both the existing product and new lines, sit in on compliance reviews, and turn what you hear into clear product direction

  • Establish the foundations of design at Adclear: the design system, the patterns, the craft bar and the way design works with engineering and go-to-market

  • Set up design process from scratch, and help build the design team over time, with the potential to lead it

  • Partner with engineering from design through implementation, staying close as things get built so the shipped product matches the intent

What you should have

  • A track record that spans early-stage chaos and later-stage scaling: you joined a company at pre-seed or seed and helped take it through to Series B, or joined at Series A and scaled it through to Series C or D. You may have covered these stages across different companies rather than one.

  • Genuine range: you're comfortable being dropped into zero-to-one ambiguity, but you've also proven you can take a product to its next level, not only start things from a blank page.

  • You've shipped code, understand how systems work under the hood, and don't need engineering to explain why something is hard

  • Prototypes in code as a default, not a last resort - You are a Figma expert and Cursor, Claude Code, or similar are already part of how you work

  • High agency: comfortable operating as the sole designer under pressure, managing a heavy and varied workload, moving quickly without sacrificing quality

What we hope you have

  • Exposure to fintech, regtech or another regulated space. A real plus, but not a must.

  • Experience designing for non-technical operators. You've built for people who use software to get a job done, like compliance reviewers and marketers, not power users who live in the tool.

  • Fluency moving between fidelities fast. Napkin sketch to clickable prototype in a day, because the fastest way to settle a debate is to make the thing real.

  • Experience building or leading a design function, or a clear point of view on how you'd start building one here.

How we work

  • Founders and the CTO are closely involved in the day-to-day, and design has a real seat at the table

  • Design drives product direction here; it doesn't decorate decisions made elsewhere

  • The pace is fast and the approach is still being built, and you're one of the people building it

  • This isn't the right role if you want a fixed formula and a full team handed to you on day one

Benefits

  • Competitive pay

  • Meaningful equity as our founding designer

  • Private healthcare and dental

  • Hardware and software budget so you have the tools you want

  • Monthly gym contribution

  • A rare chance to define the product and the design function of a fast-growing company from scratch

How to apply

Send us a link to your portfolio together with your CV. We read every application.

Gismart is a value-driven mobile app developer with a strong presence in the Health & Wellness, Utilities, and Music app markets. About project


At Radiotech, we believe music belongs to everyone — not just those who grew up taking lessons. As a product company inside the Gismart ecosystem, we’ve spent years building apps that make music feel approachable, fun, and deeply human. With 23 apps across iOS and Android and over 500 million downloads worldwide, our products have found their way into the hands of musicians, beginners, and curious souls across the globe. We see music as a universal language. Our job is to make sure more people can speak it.

The Creative Production Lead owns the strategic growth of the creative production function, translating company-level goals into team execution while building the people, processes, and cross-functional relationships needed to scale creative output. This role is a defined growth track toward Head of Creative Production, with scope expanding as the team and its impact on business metrics grow.

Responsibilities:

1. Strategy & Performance

  • Decompose company OKRs into actionable creative team goals and KPIs

  • Track OKR completion, creative output volume, and performance against targets

  • Report on team performance and creative impact to leadership

2. People Management

  • Full ownership of team management: hiring, onboarding, and performance reviews

  • Design and run career development paths, including promotion criteria

  • Build a team education program (skills growth, internal training, external learning)

  • Manage team capacity planning and workload distribution

3. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with Product, PMM, and UA teams

  • Align creative priorities with product roadmaps and UA testing needs

  • Represent creative production in cross-functional planning cycles

4. Process & Automation

  • Identify and drive automation opportunities across the creative production pipeline (briefing, asset delivery, QA, reporting)

  • Own tooling decisions and process documentation

  • Continuously reduce time-to-launch for creative assets

5. Team Culture & Knowledge Sharing

  • Establish and run team rituals (standups, retros, creative reviews)

  • Drive in-house knowledge sharing (playbooks, best-practice libraries, post-mortems)

  • Foster a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement

Experience:

  • 4+ years in creative production, creative strategy, or performance creative roles, with at least 1-2 years in a team lead or management capacity

  • Proven track record producing creative for performance marketing channels (Meta, AppLovin, TikTok, or similar)

  • Experience with mobile app or gaming creative production is a strong plus; familiarity with playable ads (e.g. Cocos Creator or similar engines) is a bonus

  • Experience managing creative production budgets and resourcing (in-house team, freelancers, or agencies)

Mindset:

  • Systems thinker — genuinely energized by building process and automation, not just managing output

  • Growth-oriented, with clear interest in scaling into a Head of Creative Production role

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, iteration-heavy environment (multiple products, frequent creative testing cycles)

Employee Benefits:

  • Remote-First Culture: Our team is diverse and extensive, just like our product portfolio. We provide a flexible working schedule and let you work anywhere in the world, either remotely or in one of our corporate hubs

  • Сoworking Compensation: We provide 100% compensation for coworking spaces in Ukraine (except Kyiv, where we have a cozy and autonomous hub) and 50% compensation for coworking spaces worldwide to make sure that everyone has a comfortable and inspiring workspace

  • Free Office Lunches: We want you to stay fueled and focused, so we provide delicious free lunches for everyone working from our hubs. It’s one less thing for you to worry about during a productive workday

  • Public Holidays Policy: Gismart observes public holidays based on the Ukrainian or Polish holiday calendars. Employees working in other locations are entitled to 12 public holidays per year

  • 100% Sick Leave Compensation

  • Mental and Physical Health: To help you stay happy and healthy, Gismart will partially cover your medical insurance, sports activities, therapy costs

  • Personal Equipment Policy: Of course, we’ll provide you with all the equipment you need or cover the maintenance cost for your own tools

  • Personal Learning and Development: We love to see you learn and grow, so Gismart will cover 70% of your professional development courses. We’ll also pay for 100% of corporate English courses

  • Time-Off Policy: Every employee gets 18 working days of paid vacation and 3 personal days per year, with an extra day added for each year at Gismart

  • Corporate Events: We are remote-first, but we love meeting up in person. Whenever possible, we organize corporate events and team-building activities across all Gismart hubs

description_html:
Job title: Mechanical Engineer – Wearable Systems & Certification

Location: Reading, UK (Hybrid)

ABOUT XYZ REALITY

──────────────────────────────

XYZ Reality are the creators of the world's first and only engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution, purpose built for the construction industry. Not only have we created this holographic technology, that sits within The Atom — a smart, site-safe headset/hardhat — but we implement it on projects, utilising the power of AR to ensure that all schemes are completed in line with delivery timescales and budgets.

XYZ has grown to over 100 staff across the UK, US & Europe and is working with Mission Critical organisations & construction companies to successfully deliver major projects.

THE ROLE

──────────────────────────────

XYZ Reality is developing the next generation of wearable augmented reality products for the construction industry — helmet-mounted systems that must perform reliably in some of the most demanding industrial environments in the world.

We are looking for a talented Mechanical Engineer to join our Hardware team and take a hands-on role in designing, certifying, and delivering these products. Working closely with our Senior Mechanical Engineer and a multidisciplinary R&D team, you'll be involved across the full product development cycle — from concept and prototyping through certification, manufacturing readiness, and production transition.

This is a role for someone who is practical, detail-oriented, and passionate about building innovative physical products — someone who takes ownership, gets into the workshop as readily as they get into CAD, and wants to see their engineering make a real-world difference.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

──────────────────────────────

• Design and develop helmet-mounted AR systems and accessories using SolidWorks — producing 3D models, assemblies, engineering drawings, and full production documentation to a high standard.

• Support ANSI Type II and EN397 certification programmes — designing for compliance from the outset, coordinating with certification bodies and testing laboratories, and supporting environmental, drop, impact, vibration, and ingress testing activities.

• Integrate sensor systems, batteries, antennas, optics, cameras, and electronics into compact wearable platforms — with attention to thermal management, electronics packaging, and wearable ergonomics throughout.

• Lead and support DFM and DFA activities — ensuring designs are manufacturable at scale, generating assembly instructions and engineering change documentation, and supporting production introduction and manufacturing transition.

• Work with external suppliers, contract manufacturers, and certification laboratories — managing relationships, reviewing outputs, and ensuring components and systems meet design intent and regulatory requirements.

• Collaborate closely with Hardware, Embedded, Production, Software, and R&D teams — participating in concept generation, design reviews, prototyping, and validation activities across the full development programme.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

──────────────────────────────

• Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, or a related discipline, with 3–5 years of product development experience from concept through prototype and into production.

• Strong SolidWorks CAD experience — including 3D modelling, assemblies, engineering drawings, and manufacturing documentation — with a solid grasp of tolerance analysis, material selection, and mechanical design principles.

• Practical, hands-on prototyping and workshop skills, with experience working across manufacturing processes including injection moulding, machining, sheet metal fabrication, and additive manufacturing.

• Experience working with external suppliers and manufacturers, and comfortable operating within a fast-paced, multidisciplinary engineering team. Familiarity with PPE, wearable products, or certification standards (ANSI, EN397, CE, UKCA) is a strong advantage.

KEY EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

──────────────────────────────

• SolidWorks CAD — 3D design, assemblies & engineering drawings

• ANSI Type II / EN397 certification & regulatory testing

• Wearable product design — helmets, PPE & head-mounted systems

• DFM / DFA & manufacturing transition support

• Sensor, optics, battery & electronics integration into wearables

• Hands-on prototyping, practical workshop & problem-solving skills

BENEFITS

──────────────────────────────

🏝️ 25 days annual leave + public holidays

🩺 Private healthcare with Vitality

🎄 Christmas shutdown days on top of leave allowance (2–4 per year usually)

🏠 Hybrid working

🪙 Biannual salary reviews

🥳 Summer & Christmas staff parties

💰 Employee referral scheme

🚀 Make a real-world impact of revolutionising the construction industry

description_html:
About us:

At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Generative AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn’t just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

We’re looking for a Head of Legal who will lead our legal operations, ensuring our client and vendor contracting processes align with our business strategy, evolving legal standards, and risk management requirements. To do this successfully, you'll need to understand the rapidly changing GenAI regulatory environment, expertly navigate complex contract negotiations, and position Pencil as a trusted leader in AI compliance and best practices.

Key responsibilities:

  • Negotiate and manage client contracts, including redlining Master Service Agreements (MSAs) and Pencil’s standard Terms & Conditions to ensure alignment with business objectives and risk management.

  • Oversee agreements with AI technology vendors, ensuring vendor terms effectively align back-to-back with Pencil’s client obligations.

  • Act as embedded legal counsel to product teams, reviewing new features and AI capabilities for legal and regulatory risk before launch, and advising on design decisions in real time rather than after the fact.

  • Monitor the evolving AI and data regulatory landscape (e.g., EU AI Act, GDPR, sector-specific guidance) and proactively brief product and leadership on implications, translating regulatory change into practical product and commercial strategy.

  • Develop, maintain, and continuously update Pencil’s legal documentation, such as Terms & Conditions, Data Processing Agreements (DPAs), and Privacy Policies, keeping pace with advancements in AI technology.

  • Consult with client legal teams to clearly communicate and validate Pencil's legal and technical safety protocols, facilitating trust and compliance.

  • Create thought leadership content such as whitepapers and participate in speaking engagements about legal issues related to Generative AI in marketing.

 

Your background

  • JD, LLB or equivalent law degree, and active membership in good standing of at least one state bar.

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience as a commercial or corporate attorney, specifically within the AI space.

  • Proven experience in negotiating complex contracts with clients and technology vendors.

  • Experience handling 8-figure deal value contracts with enterprise scale clients.

  • Deep understanding of data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) and intellectual property law.

  • Strong ability to clearly communicate complex legal concepts to diverse stakeholders.

  • Previous experience in drafting industry whitepapers or speaking engagements is highly desirable.

KPIs & Success Measures

  • Average MSA/T&Cs redline-to-signature cycle time

  • % of client contracts closed without material deviation from Pencil's standard paper

  • DPAs, Privacy Policy, and T&Cs reviewed/updated on a fixed cadence

Benefits:

About Unity Advisory

Unity Advisory is a challenger advisory firm. Built for the AI-enabled world, we operate a lean, conflict-free model that embeds AI across all workstreams. Free from audit conflicts, focused entirely on high-impact outcomes for CFOs making high-consequence decisions. We're scaling fast and building the commercial infrastructure to match.

The Role

This is a builder role. You'll help design, build and maintain the systems that power Unity Advisory's go-to-market engine — the data pipelines, outreach infrastructure, enrichment workflows and automation that gets us in front of the right CFOs and PE deal teams at the right moment.

You think in code and workflows, not spreadsheets. You have hands-on experience with GTM tooling, know how to work with APIs, and are comfortable in a terminal as well as a slide deck. You'll work closely with senior stakeholders to keep the commercial machine fast, accurate and converting.

Responsibilities

  • Support the build and maintenance of automated pipelines that enrich, segment and score target lists — CFOs at PE-backed businesses, finance leaders across our core sectors.

  • Integrate data sources (Companies House, Dealroom, LinkedIn, news feeds) to surface trigger events: funding rounds, leadership changes, new deals.

  • Build and manage multi-channel outreach sequences across email and LinkedIn using tools like Clay, Apollo or Instantly.

  • Write and iterate on outreach copy — specific, well-timed, and nothing like a template.

  • Automate follow-up cadences and meeting scheduling so senior team members stay focused on conversations, not admin.

  • Contribute to the GTM tech stack — CRM, enrichment tools, sequencing platforms, AI tooling.

  • Build and maintain reporting dashboards that show what's been sent, what's landed and what's converted.

  • Identify and flag pipeline bottlenecks and implement fixes programmatically.

What You'll Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience working with GTM systems in a B2B or SaaS environment.

  • Solid coding ability — Python, JavaScript or similar. Comfortable building lightweight tools when off-the-shelf doesn't cut it.

  • Hands-on experience with the modern GTM stack: Clay, Apollo, HubSpot, Instantly, LinkedIn Sales Nav, and AI tooling for enrichment and content generation.

  • Comfortable with APIs, webhooks and no-code/low-code tools (Zapier, Make, n8n).

  • Good written communication — you can write outreach copy as well as you can write code.

  • Organised, structured and able to manage your own workload with minimal supervision.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with the CFO, finance buyer or PE landscape.

  • Exposure to ABM, pipeline analytics or event-based campaign execution.

  • Experience contributing to a GTM function build-out.

Why This Role?

Real ownership, high visibility and the chance to see the direct impact of what you build. You'll work closely with a fast-moving team and play a meaningful role in shaping how a growing advisory firm goes to market. We're building something different — and we want people who want to build it with us.

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process. If you need any adjustments at any stage, please let us know.

We do not accept unsolicited CVs from third party agencies.

title: Senior Manager - Transfer Pricing

description_html:
About Unity Advisory

Unity Advisory is a pure-play, experience-led CFO advisory firm providing integrated finance, commercial, tax and deals support. We are free from audit conflicts and AI-enabled by design, combining deep technical expertise with automation, analytics and AI built into the delivery of every engagement. We are building an alternative to traditional advisory firms, focused on clarity over complexity, outcomes over hours, and practical advice delivered at pace for CFOs making high-consequence decisions.


The Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager to join our Transfer Pricing practice, supporting a client base of PE-backed businesses and high-growth international companies. This is a hands-on advisory role — you will lead engagements, own client relationships, and bring real technical depth to cross-border structuring, documentation, and transactions.

You will work directly with CFOs and tax directors, and you will have the opportunity to shape how our transfer pricing practice grows. Unlike a large firm, there is no bureaucracy between you and the work that matters.

Responsibilities

  • Lead transfer pricing engagements from scoping through delivery, covering documentation, policy design, intercompany structuring, and HMRC defence

  • Advise on the tax and commercial implications of cross-border transactions, including leverage and deductibility in PE-backed structures

  • Identify and manage transfer pricing risks in fast-moving transaction environments, coordinating across deal and tax workstreams

  • Prepare and negotiate Advance Pricing Agreements and support clients through audits and enquiries

  • Manage compliance deliverables including CTSA documentation and OECD-aligned local file and master file requirements

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, including CFOs, tax directors, and PE finance teams

  • Use AI and automation tools in the delivery of analysis and documentation — we expect our people to work smarter, not just harder

  • Mentor and develop junior team members, providing clear direction and quality feedback on their work

  • Contribute to business development by identifying opportunities within existing clients and supporting targeted outreach

    What You'll Bring

  • ACA, CTA, or equivalent qualification, or demonstrable experience at Senior Manager level in transfer pricing

  • Solid grounding in UK and international transfer pricing regulations, OECD guidelines, and BEPS

  • Experience advising PE-backed or high-growth businesses, with an understanding of financing structures, leverage, and cross-border tax considerations

  • A track record of managing client engagements end-to-end, including financial and risk management

  • Strong commercial instincts — you understand what clients actually need and you know how to deliver it clearly

  • Proven ability to build relationships with senior stakeholders and communicate complex technical positions in plain language

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, project-based environment with multiple concurrent engagements

  • Genuine interest in technology and AI-enabled ways of working — we want people who are curious about how tools can make advice sharper and faster

Work Environment

Hybrid and flexible — we trust our people to manage their time and deliver excellent work. You will spend time with clients and in the office, and we will not count the hours in between.

We offer the opportunity to be at the forefront of AI-driven advisory services. You'll be working on cutting-edge projects and encouraged to deploy the latest analytical tools and approaches. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a fast-growing business and shape your career.

Additional Information

At Unity Advisory, we are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. In line with the Equality Act 2010, we will accommodate any suitable candidate requiring assistance to attend or conduct an interview. If you need any adjustments or support, please let us know when either scheduling your interview or in your application cover letter. We are dedicated to ensuring that everyone has an equal opportunity to succeed and are here to support you throughout the process.

PLEASE NOTE THAT WE DO NOT ACCEPT ANY THIRD PARTY UNSOLICITED CVS

description_html:
About Us

We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fueling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.

Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.

We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation.

Here’s a little more:

  • Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)

  • Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more

  • Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission

  • Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages

  • Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word

The Role

Taptap send is building a Business product, leveraging the best-in-class cross-border payment network we have built. This is a new product line we’re building from the ground up and we are looking for a hungry, hands-on generalist to build and scale the operations behind it. You will own high impact, high urgency, needle-moving goals on a new and fast growing product in an established start up.

Taptap Send Business is early and growing fast. Businesses are already using us to pay people and suppliers across emerging markets, and we are launching a wider set of products and geographies. Every launch is a new promise to a business customer whose payroll, suppliers and cash flow depend on us getting it right.

This role reports to the Director of Business Operations and owns the service our business customers get. You will be given high agency and high autonomy, working across Product, Data, Engineering and Compliance to build and run best-in-class support for a product line that is growing fast.

The outcome you will drive

  • Business customer retention — build an AI native account management support that is an order of magnitude better than anything on the market.

  • A service excellence our BPO partners deliver to, consistently, as volume and product complexity increase.

  • Launch readiness — every new product and geography requires specific support, you build it and run it.

  • Insight to build a Product businesses love — you’re the closest to what business customers actually ask, you quantify it and get it into the roadmap.

  • Cost of support — own the budget for support and make it more efficient with scale.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build and run best-in-class support for the Business product, end to end

  • Identify unhappy paths, build and automate solutions and work with product to fix at scale

  • Design, build and maintain AI-powered workflows and automations that reduce manual effort, improve retention and scale Operations effectively

  • Take operational functions and processes from 0 to 1, then 1 to 100

  • Set the standard our BPO partners are held to — playbooks, QA, KPIs — and hold the performance bar high

  • Structure complex and ambiguous problems by conducting ad hoc analysis

  • Act as Product Ops for the Business line: turn what customers tell us into evidenced product priorities, and get them built

  • Work across highly technical and specialised product, engineering and data colleagues to deliver an experience business customers stay for

  • Own support for each new launch, from readiness through to a steady, automated state

Requirements

  • 5-7+ years of high-performing experience in a fast pace, analytical environment

  • B2B account management, customer success or business operations for a business/SME product is what we are looking for, you know what business customers expect and what it takes to deliver it

  • You are looking for a role where you can directly drive the impact, where you are the owner and have autonomy to make decisions and drive outcomes

  • You take ownership, are dependable, and do the hard things to make things work. You own the problems end-to-end and constantly ship improvements

  • Comfortable using SQL to drive decisions daily

  • Willingness to build and iterate on AI-powered workflows and automations

  • No task too small, willingness to dive in and sweat the details regardless of the tool or problem

  • Instinct to add 'just enough' process to scale without cumbersome bureaucracy

  • Comfortable in a regulated, 24/7 business where the stakes for the customer are real

  • London, office based

How we work

A BizOps role at Taptap Send is a super Individual Contributor. For your topic you are the single threaded owner, the analyst, the product manager, the engineer and the operations lead. In practice you don’t wait for others, you leverage AI to get things done and build what drives the outcome you seek.

This is not a coordination role, and it is not a strategy-deck role. If your best work has been influencing other teams to build things, this will be a frustrating job. If you have been waiting for a role where you are simply allowed to go and fix it, this is that role.

This role is a launchpad — previous BizOps hires have gone on to lead functions and launch products.

Taptap Values 

Impact first

Team next

Accept reality

Propose solutions

Win with grit

Be proactively candid, with yourself and others

Love the particular

Own it

Create positive energy

Maybe, even have fun

Taptap Send is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment decisions are decided on the basis of qualifications, experience and business need. We strongly encourage applications who are members of underrepresented communities to apply.

If you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the recruitment process, please do not hesitate to let us know. Any information you provide us in this respect will only be used to accommodate your requirements.

Note: we recognize imposter syndrome is real - any candidate that does not perfectly fit every characteristic of this role is still strongly encouraged to apply.

At Unmind, we're here to create better mental health.

We believe mental health should be a source of strength, not struggle – for people, teams, and entire organisations.

We combine science, technology, and human care to help companies like Uber, Disney, Major League Baseball, and the NHS improve mental health and drive performance.

Now we’re looking for more brilliant people to help us do it.

🚀 Our Values

We’re building a company where ambition and empathy go hand in hand.

Outpace the rest – Move fast. Deliver excellence.

Stronger together – We go further, faster, together.

Client first – We win, when our clients win.

🌈 Inclusion & Belonging

We’re building a place where everyone feels seen, heard, and supported – and where difference is celebrated.

🎯 The Role — Technical Lead

We're looking for a Technical Lead to join one of our product teams, reporting to an Engineering Manager. You'll play a key role in enabling the team to build at pace and to a quality our users and clients can rely on.

This means partnering with the Product Manager to find lean ways of moving the team's metrics, representing technology needs for the roadmap and owning the team's technical direction, quality and approach.

The role is hands-on - building alongside the team's other Engineers and managing your own time between delivery and leadership work. You'll also work with our Staff Engineers to align the team's work with longer-term technical direction across our domains.

Our stack includes TypeScript, React, GraphQL, Node.js, Python, Golang and SQL. You don't need hands-on experience with every tool; we're more interested in strong software engineering fundamentals and curiosity to learn.

You'll embed AI into how you deliver. Use Claude Code throughout your workflow – scoping, designing, coding, reviewing, documenting – and contribute to our collective learning by sharing what's working back to the team.

In this role, you'll:

  • Partner with the Product Manager as their technical counterpart - finding lean ways of moving the team's metrics while meeting our technical governance needs; pressure-testing priorities and approach; and shaping what gets built using technical and business knowledge.

  • Represent technology in product and roadmap conversations - technical goals, non-functional requirements and the technical investments needed to keep the team moving - working with Staff Engineers to align with Unmind's longer-term technical direction across domains.

  • Own the technical direction of the team - architecture, day-to-day technical decisions and technical risk - ensuring what's built progresses towards Unmind's broader technology direction.

  • Own the technical quality of the team's work - reviewing technical plans, raising the team's technical thinking and making sure what we ship works as intended.

  • Own the technical sequencing of the team's work - how technical work breaks down, how dependencies are handled and where the risks lie. You are the first point of contact for the EM when the team's technical work affects project-level delivery.

  • Build alongside the team - taking on complex work, raising the quality bar and mentoring the engineers around them on craft.

🌟 About You

Experience in the following is important for this position:

  • Proven track record as a Senior Engineer in product-focused teams - you've designed and shipped complex software, made architectural decisions and raised the bar of those around you through review and mentoring.

  • Strong track record of partnering with Product Managers, or similar product leadership roles - shaping what gets built rather than just executing on briefs, by bringing technical and business knowledge into product conversations.

  • A product and business mindset - you understand the business context of what you build, think in terms of user and business outcomes and connect technical decisions to value.

  • Experience making technical trade-offs with confidence - knowing when to optimise for pace, when to invest in quality and when to push back on scope or approach.

  • Comfortable communicating technical context to non-engineers - in writing and in person, with PMs, business stakeholders and across the wider organisation.

  • Able to operate with sound judgement and independence - making good calls with imperfect information, knowing when to involve others and managing your own time between hands-on work and leadership.

Logistics

Compensation is highly competitive. We're also able to sponsor visas for the right candidate.

You will play a critical role in delivering high-quality penetration testing engagements across infrastructure, cloud, web, and mobile applications for a diverse range of clients, including software, fintech, manufacturing, engineering, legal, and public sector organisations.

Essential Skills

  • CHECK Team Member (CTM) status

  • At least 2+ years of penetration testing experience.

  • Strong experience with web application and network penetration testing methodologies.

  • In-depth knowledge of operating systems (Linux, Windows, Active Directory).

  • Familiarity with cloud environments and ability to perform cloud security reviews.

  • Proficiency with tools such as BurpSuite Pro, Nmap, Nessus, and Kali Linux.

  • Knowledge of scripting languages (Python, Shell, etc.).

Nice-to-Have

  • CHECK Team Lead (CTL) status (Infrastructure or Applications).

  • Relevant certifications (OSCP, Cyber Scheme).

  • Experience with Hack the Box or Capture the Flag simulations.

Why Join Instil?

At Instil, we believe great work starts with happy, motivated people. That’s why we’ve built a benefits package that supports your wellbeing, growth, and life outside of work, because when you thrive, so do we.

  • Recognition That Matters: A discretionary annual performance bonus that rewards your impact and contribution to our success.

  • Flexibility Built In: Flexible working arrangements and summer hours, because life isn’t 9 to 5, and balance matters.

  • Financial Security: A highly competitive pension scheme with generous employer contributions, private healthcare, and life assurance for peace of mind.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Employee Assistance Programme, mental health support, cycle-to-work scheme, and regular social events to keep our culture vibrant.

  • Time to Recharge: 35 days holiday, enhanced maternity pay, and family-first policies so you can focus on what matters most.

  • Learning Never Stops: From courses to certifications, we’ll invest in your development so you can keep growing and shaping what’s next.

  • Community & Culture: Opportunities to volunteer, give back, and be part of initiatives that make Instil a truly inclusive and connected workplace.

And that’s just the start, drop us a note to find out more.

Company Description

Instil has been delivering world-class software engineering and technology solutions for over 20 years, trusted by global brands to solve complex challenges and drive innovation. From modernising legacy systems to building cutting-edge applications, we help our clients navigate an ever-changing digital landscape with confidence and agility.

We’re proud to be an award-winning employer, reflecting how our people are at the heart of everything we do:

  • Recognised as a Great Place to Work® for three consecutive years, and in 2024 ranked in the Top 20 Best Workplaces in the UK for medium-sized companies.

  • Winner of Company of the Year at the Digital DNA Awards 2022, celebrating excellence in Northern Ireland’s tech sector.

Driven by a love for technology and a commitment to excellence, we bring together people who want to make a difference. We’ll support your journey, because your success is part of ours.

title: Country Manager - Software Unternehmen - Private Equity (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Options Group
description_html:
Wir unterstützen ein von Private Equity finanziertes Softwareunternehmen im Gesundheitswesen bei der Besetzung der Position eines Country Managers (m/w/d) und künftigen CEO (m/w/d), der das Unternehmen zu einem Exit führen soll.

Nach einer kürzlich getätigten Investition steht das Unternehmen vor einer wichtigen Phase des Wachstums, der Professionalisierung und der Produktentwicklung. Derzeit erwirtschaftet es einen Umsatz von weniger als 3 Millionen Euro, ist jedoch hochprofitabel.

Aufgaben

Der künftige Country Manager wird die Gesamtverantwortung für das Unternehmen übernehmen und eng mit dem bestehenden Team, dem Gründer und den Gesellschaftern zusammenarbeiten, um die Leistung zu steigern, die Softwareplattform weiterzuentwickeln und das Unternehmen innerhalb von etwa 18 Monaten auf einen möglichen Exit vorzubereiten.

Die Besetzung dieser Position ist Teil einer geplanten Führungsnachfolge. Der Gründer und derzeitige CEO wird während einer anfänglichen Übergangsphase eng mit dem neuen Country Manager zusammenarbeiten und ihm sein Wissen über das Geschäft, den Markt und wichtige Kundenbeziehungen zur Verfügung stellen.

Die Übergangsphase wird voraussichtlich etwa 6 bis 9 Monate dauern, wobei die Übergabe je nachdem, wie schnell sich der neue Country Manager einarbeiten und Verantwortung übernehmen kann, auch früher erfolgen könnte.

Zu den Aufgaben gehören:

  • Übernahme der vollen Verantwortung für die P&L sowie Erreichen der Wachstums- und Rentabilitätsziele
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem bestehenden Team zur Verbesserung und Weiterentwicklung der Softwareplattform auf Basis von Kundenfeedback und sich wandelnden Marktanforderungen
  • Vorantreiben der Implementierung von KI-Funktionen sowie Identifizierung praktischer Anwendungsfälle, die die Plattform verbessern, das Kundenerlebnis steigern und die Effizienz erhöhen
  • Umsetzung von Kundenbedürfnissen und Markterkenntnissen in klare Produktprioritäten und Entwicklungsinitiativen
  • Ein kleines, hochspezialisiertes Team leiten, motivieren und weiterentwickeln
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Private-Equity-Gesellschafter und dem Vorstand bei der Umsetzung des Value Creation Plans
  • Vorbereitung des Unternehmens auf einen möglichen Exit

Qualifikation

Der ideale Kandidat bringt Folgendes mit:

  • Führungserfahrung in einem B2B-Softwareunternehmen
  • Vorherige P&L responsibility, idealerweise als Country Manager, Geschäftsführer, General Manager, CEO oder in einer vergleichbaren Führungsposition
  • Ein tiefgreifendes Verständnis für Softwareprodukte und Geschäftsmodelle
  • Interesse an KI und deren praktischer Anwendung in Softwareprodukten und Geschäftsprozessen
  • Eine kundenorientierte Denkweise und Erfahrung darin, Kundenfeedback in Produktverbesserungen umzusetzen
  • Die Fähigkeit, strategisches Denken mit einer sehr praxisorientierten und pragmatischen Herangehensweise zu verbinden
  • Flüssige Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse sind unerlässlich, gepaart mit ausgeprägten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im Umgang mit Kunden, Mitarbeitern, Gesellschaftern und anderen Stakeholdern

Benefits

  • Möglichkeit remote zu arbeiten - Reisebereitschaft vorausgesetzt
  • Wichtige Standorte sind der Großraum München sowie die Schweiz
  • Signifikanter Exit-Bonus
  • Möglichkeit zum CEO aufzusteigen sowie Einstieg in das Private Equity Geschäft

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbungen!

title: B2B Marketing Working Student (m|w|d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at idealo internet GmbH
description_html:
B2B marketing works best when performance data and clear communication come together. Campaigns need to reach the right audience, while content across LinkedIn, CRM and the website needs to stay relevant and consistent. At idealo, you support our B2B Marketing team across both performance marketing and communications, gaining hands-on experience with real campaigns and recurring marketing activities.

Your Responsibilities

  • You support paid campaigns on Google and LinkedIn and help keep them running smoothly.

  • You monitor campaign results and prepare simple performance reports.

  • You create and update B2B content for LinkedIn, newsletters and our website.

  • You research competitors, market trends and relevant B2B topics.



Skills & Requirements

Must-have

  • You are currently studying marketing, business, communications, media or a related subject.

  • You are comfortable working with numbers and have good German and English skills.

  • You take ownership and independently drive topics forward.

  • You bring intrinsic motivation and a proactive mindset.

Nice-to-have

  • First marketing experience or basic knowledge of paid social, analytics, CRM or Canva.

At idealo you can expect

  • You want to further your education? We take your personal development goals seriously and, in addition to our idealo Learning Hub, eLearning offerings (e.g., Udemy), coaching & mediation, we also offer you the opportunity to benefit individually from additional learning and development budget.

  • And what about the office? Our office in the heart of Berlin offers free organic breakfast, excellent free lunch (vegan and vegetarian), as well as free coffee, lemonades and after-work beer, in addition to the "standard foosball". It also has a fabulous rooftop terrace with view of the whole of berlin where you can network with colleagues from our group of companies.

  • In need of additional support in any areas of your life? We offer free counseling and support in all areas of life (professional, private, family, health, etc.) in cooperation with the pme-Familienservice.

  • Want to keep yourself fit? We offer many different fitness and sports options, such as an Urban Sports or Gympass membership, to suit your personal needs.

  • And what else is there? Of course, success must be celebrated! In addition to team events, you can also expect big company events and other moments of organized connection with others in the company and your team throughout the year!

title: Mitarbeiter Datenmanagement & KI (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Finanz Protect GmbH
description_html:
Sie verstehen Daten, denken in Prozessen und haben Freude daran, digitale Abläufe zu verbessern? Dann gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Versicherungsverwaltung.

Die Finanz Protect GmbH ist ein Finanz- und Versicherungsmakler mit Sitz am Phoenixsee in Dortmund und betreut Kunden bundesweit. Wir wachsen und suchen Unterstützung für unser Daten- und Schnittstellenmanagement sowie für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Automatisierungs- und KI-Prozesse.

Bei uns sorgen Sie dafür, dass Kunden- und Vertragsdaten zuverlässig verarbeitet werden, Systeme miteinander kommunizieren und aus manuellen Arbeitsschritten effiziente digitale Abläufe werden. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit der Geschäftsführung, unserem Team und externen Softwarepartnern zusammen.

Aufgaben

  • Datenmanagement und Datenqualität: Sie pflegen und strukturieren Kunden- und Vertragsdaten in unserem Maklerverwaltungsprogramm, erkennen Dubletten und Unstimmigkeiten und sorgen für eine verlässliche Datenbasis.
  • BiPRO-Abruf: Sie richten digitale Abrufe von Versicherungsdokumenten und Daten ein, überwachen deren Verarbeitung und stellen die korrekte Zuordnung zu Kunden und Verträgen sicher.
  • GDV-Datenverarbeitung: Sie importieren und verarbeiten GDV-Bestandsdaten, gleichen diese mit vorhandenen Datensätzen ab und klären fehlerhafte oder unvollständige Übertragungen.
  • Schnittstellenmanagement: Sie betreuen die Anbindungen zwischen Maklerverwaltungsprogramm, Versicherern, Maklerpools und weiteren Anwendungen. Bei Störungen koordinieren Sie die Fehleranalyse und Behebung mit den jeweiligen Ansprechpartnern.
  • Bestandsintegration: Sie unterstützen die Übernahme zugekaufter Versicherungsbestände durch die Aufbereitung, Übertragung und Qualitätskontrolle der Kunden- und Vertragsdaten.
  • Automatisierung: Sie identifizieren wiederkehrende manuelle Aufgaben und entwickeln automatisierte Abläufe, beispielsweise für Dokumentenzuordnung, Datenpflege und interne Bearbeitungsprozesse.
  • KI- Prozesse: Sie erproben und integrieren KI-Anwendungen für die Dokumentenerkennung, Informationsextraktion und Unterstützung im Tagesgeschäft. Dabei prüfen Sie die Ergebnisse auf Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit.
  • Dokumentation und Wissenstransfer: Sie dokumentieren Abläufe verständlich und unterstützen das Team bei der sicheren Anwendung neuer digitaler Prozesse.

Qualifikation

Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Versicherungsbereich, in der IT oder im kaufmännischen Bereich mit ausgeprägtem technischem Schwerpunkt – oder über vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung.

Sie bringen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Versicherungsdaten, Maklerverwaltungsprogrammen oder digitalen Verwaltungsprozessen mit.

Kenntnisse in BiPRO, GDV-Datenverarbeitung und Schnittstellenmanagement sind besonders willkommen. In einzelne Themen können Sie sich bei entsprechender Vorerfahrung und Lernbereitschaft einarbeiten.

Sie arbeiten sicher mit Excel und können Daten strukturiert aufbereiten, abgleichen und auf Fehler prüfen.

Sie haben praktische Erfahrung mit Automatisierungswerkzeugen wie Make oder Power Automate beziehungsweise großes Interesse, sich darin zu vertiefen.

Sie nutzen KI-Anwendungen praxisorientiert und können beurteilen, an welchen Stellen diese sinnvoll eingesetzt werden und wo eine menschliche Prüfung erforderlich bleibt.

Kenntnisse in APIs, Datenformaten wie CSV, XML oder JSON sowie grundlegende Programmierkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

Sie arbeiten sorgfältig, analytisch und eigenverantwortlich. Auch bei komplexen Datenbeständen behalten Sie den Überblick und gehen Fehlern systematisch auf den Grund.

Sie gehen verantwortungsbewusst mit sensiblen Kunden- und Vertragsdaten um und können technische Zusammenhänge verständlich vermitteln.

Benefits

Unsere Benefits für Mitarbeiter/innen:

  • Eine Position mit Gestaltungsspielraum und direktem Einfluss auf unsere digitale Weiterentwicklung
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung, kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien
  • Modernes Büro im RIVA-Gebäude am Phoenixsee in Dortmund
  • Moderne Software, KI-Anwendungen und technische Ausstattung
  • Monatliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung
  • Flexibles Gleitzeitmodell
  • Attraktive Mitarbeiterkonditionen für eigene Versicherungen und Depots
  • Betriebliche Altersversorgung mit Zuschuss
  • Über 300 Gesundheitsleistungen, darunter Physiotherapie, Zahnreinigung, Brillenzuschüsse und Massagen
  • Premium-Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft inklusive Sauna
  • Höhenverstellbare Schreibtische und ergonomische Bürostühle
  • Kostenfreie Getränke wie Wasser, Kaffee und Softdrinks

Bei der Finanz Protect GmbH legen wir großen Wert auf das Wohlbefinden und die Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeiter. Wir bieten Ihnen nicht nur spannende Aufgaben und vielfältige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, sondern auch attraktive Benefits, um Ihnen den Arbeitsalltag angenehm zu gestalten.

Sie möchten Daten nicht nur verwalten, sondern dafür sorgen, dass Prozesse besser funktionieren? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen.

Senden Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf und erzählen Sie uns kurz, mit welchen Systemen, Schnittstellen oder Automatisierungen Sie bereits gearbeitet haben. Geben Sie bitte auch Ihren möglichen Eintrittstermin, Ihren gewünschten Stundenumfang und Ihre Gehaltsvorstellung an.
